p75mock006.en: A bullet train covers a fixed distance in 40 minutes at an average speed of 180 km/h. Due to track maintenance, it needs to be diverted, increasing the distance by 25%. If the train must still arrive at its destination on time (i.e. in 40 minutes), what should its new average speed be (in km/h)?
p75mock006.hi: एक बुलेट ट्रेन 180 km/h की औसत गति से 40 मिनट में एक निश्चित दूरी तय करती है। ट्रैक के रखरखाव के कारण , उसे दूसरे रास्ते से मोड़ना पड़ता है , जिससे दूरी 25% बढ़ जाती है। यदि ट्रेन को अभी भी अपने गंतव्य पर समय पर ( यानी 40 मिनट में ) पहुँचना है , तो उसकी नई औसत गति (km/h में ) क्या होनी चाहिए ?
p75mock006.sol: Same Time → Dist. ∝ Speed Dist → 4:5 ⇒ Speed → 4:5 4 → 180 km/h ⇒ 5 → 225 km/h

p75mock006.sol: Acid after removing = 3×36L/4 = 27L Acid in another solution = 12×1/4 = 3L [IMG] = 5:3

p75mock006.en: A and B complete a work in 24 and 30 days, respectively, working 10 hours per day. The work is to be done in two shifts. The morning shift is for 6 hours and the evening shift is for 4 hours. On the first day, A works in the morning and B works in the evening, and they interchange their shifts every day. On which day did the work get completed?
p75mock006.hi: A और B एक काम को क्रमशः 24 और 30 दिनों में पूरा करते हैं , प्रतिदिन 10 घंटे काम करते हैं। काम दो शिफ्ट में किया जाना है। सुबह की शिफ्ट 6 घंटे की है और शाम की शिफ्ट 4 घंटे की है। पहले दिन , A सुबह काम करता है और B शाम को काम करता है , और वे हर दिन अपनी शिफ्ट बदलते हैं। किस दिन काम पूरा हुआ ?
p75mock006.sol: Ratio of time taken by A and B = 24 : 30= 4 : 5 Ration of Efficiency of A and B = 5 : 4 Total work =5 × 24 × 10 =1200 Work done on 1st day = 5 × 6 + 4 × 4 = 46 Work done on 2nd day = 4 × 6 + 5 × 4 = 44 Total work completed in 2 days = 90 So, 90 unit work = 2 days 1170 unit work = 26 days 1200 unit work = 26 + [IMG] = [IMG] days Therefore work will be completed on 27 th day.
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 12550. 8194 + 4356 = 8190 + 4 + 4360 - 4 = 12550

p75mock007.en: A sum of ₹1,50,000 is distributed among three persons A, B and C - so that they receive 20%, 30% and 50%, respectively. A receives the same amount from another sum of money which is distributed among them so that they receive 50%, 30% and 20%, respectively. Find the total amount received from both sums of money, by B.
p75mock007.hi: ₹1,50,000 की राशि तीन व्यक्तियों A, B और C के बीच इस प्रकार वितरित की जाती है कि उन्हें क्रमशः 20%, 30% और 50% प्राप्त होता है। A को एक अन्य राशि से समान राशि प्राप्त होती है जिसे उनके बीच इस प्रकार वितरित किया जाता है कि उन्हें क्रमशः 50%, 30% और 20% प्राप्त होता है। B द्वारा दोनों राशियों से प्राप्त कुल राशि ज्ञात कीजिए।
p75mock007.sol: Sum = ₹1,50,000 1. A → 20%→1,50,000× [IMG] =₹30,000 2. A→50%→30,000 Then 100%→₹60,000 Amount received by B in the second sum = [IMG]60000 = ₹18000 Amount received by B in the First sum = [IMG]150000 = ₹45000 Total amount received by B = 18000 + 45000 = ₹63000

p75mock007.en: In [IMG] PQR, [IMG] PQR = 135°, PQ = 8 [IMG] cm and PR = 17 cm. What is the length [in cm] of QR?
p75mock007.hi: [IMG] PQR में , [IMG] PQR = 135°, PQ = 8 [IMG] सेमी और PR = 17 सेमी। QR की लंबाई [ सेमी में ] क्या है ?
p75mock007.sol: [IMG] Given that, PQ = 8√2, PR=17 Δ ∠PQR = 135 ̊ R let QR = x Method-I: Cos θ = [IMG] Then, Cos 135 ̊= x 2 +[8 2 ] 2 - [17 ] 2 2× x ×8 2 [IMG] ⇒ - 16x = x 2 - 161 x 2 + 16x - 161=0 [x + 23][x – 7]=0 x = - 23 or x = 7 ∴ QR=7cm. Method: {2}: [IMG] Using construction; Produced RQ at 0 such that PO ⊥ QR Now, in △POQ, ∠PQO =180 - 135 = 45 ̊ ∴∠ OPQ = 45 ̊ So OP = OQ = a {let} Using Pythagoras, in △OPQ a√2 = 8√2 a = 8cm Now: in △OPR, triplet [8,15,17], side OR = 15cm then QR= 15 – 8 =7cm.

p75mock007.en: A train takes 7 seconds to pass man standing on a platform and another train whose length is double that of the first train, and moving in the opposite direction, takes 10 seconds to pass him. The time taken [in seconds, to the nearest integer] by the trains to pass each other will be:
p75mock007.hi: एक ट्रेन प्लेटफॉर्म पर खड़े आदमी को पार करने में 7 सेकंड का समय लेती है और दूसरी ट्रेन जिसकी लंबाई पहली ट्रेन की लंबाई से दोगुनी है और विपरीत दिशा में चल रही है , उसे पार करने में 10 सेकंड का समय लेती है। ट्रेनों द्वारा एक - दूसरे को पार करने में लिया गया समय [ सेकंड में , निकटतम पूर्णांक तक ] होगा :
p75mock007.sol: Let D be the length of the first train [in meters], v be the speed of the first train [in m/s], u be the speed of the second train [in m/s]. The first train takes 7 seconds to pass a man, so its speed is v = [IMG] m/s. The second train has length 2D and takes 10 seconds to pass a man, so its speed is u = [IMG] = D/5 m/s. Since the trains are moving in opposite directions, their relative speed is v + u = [IMG] + [IMG] = [IMG] m/s. The total length the trains need to cover to pass each other is 3D. The time taken will be = [IMG] t = [IMG] = [IMG] = 8.75 seconds. ~ 9 seconds

p75mock007.hi: ΔABC में , D, E और F क्रमशः भुजा BC, CA और AB के मध्य - बिंदु हैं। यदि BC = 14.4 सेमी , CA = 15.2 सेमी और AB = 12.4 सेमी है , तो Δ DEF का परिमाप [ सेमी में ] क्या है ?

p75mock007.en: What is the compound interest on a sum of ₹8,100 for [IMG] years at 8% per annum, if the interest is compounded 5- monthly? [Nearest to an integer]

p75mock007.sol: Effective rate when compounded 5- monthly = 8% × [IMG] = [IMG] % for [IMG] years or 15 months the 3 cycles of interest will be there Compound interest for 3 cycles = 3a+3b+c Where, a = Principal × R% = 8,100× [IMG] % = 270 3a= 270×3= ₹810 b= Principal × R%× R% =8,100× [IMG] % × [IMG] % =9 3b= 9×3 = 27 c= Principal × R%× R%× R% =8,100× [IMG] % × [IMG] % × [IMG] % =0.3 3a+3b+c = 810+27+0.3=837.3 ∼ Rs. 837 approx.

p75mock007.en: The average weight of a group of 12 girls is 48 kg. If 2 girls R and S replace P and Q, the new average weight becomes 46 kg. The weight of P = the weight of Q. p75mock007.en: A tap can fill an oil tank in 14 hours. After half the tank is filled, 7 more similar taps are opened. What is the total time taken to fill the oil tank completely?
p75mock007.hi: एक नल 14 घंटे में एक तेल का टैंक भर सकता है। जब आधा टैंक भर जाता है , तो 7 और वैसे ही नल खोल दिए जाते हैं। तेल के टैंक को पूरी तरह भरने में कुल कितना समय लगेगा ?
p75mock007.sol: A can fill oil tank in 14 hour Assume capacity of oil tank = 14 units Efficiency of A = 14/14 = 1 unit/hour 7 units of tank (half) filled by A in 7 hours now, 7 more taps opened, efficiency of 8 similar taps = 8 units/hour To fill remaining 7 units time taken = 7/8 hour = 52 min 30 second Total time taken = 7 hour 52 min 30 second

p75mock007.en: A swimmer swims from a point P against the current for 6 min and then swims back along the current for next 6 min and reaches at a point Q. If the distance between P and Q is 120 m then the speed of the current [in km/h] is:
p75mock007.hi: एक तैराक बिंदु P से धारा के विपरीत 6 मिनट तक तैरता है और फिर अगले 6 मिनट तक धारा के साथ तैरता है और बिंदु Q पर पहुँचता है। यदि P और Q के बीच की दूरी 120 मीटर है तो धारा की गति [ किमी / घंटा में ] है :
p75mock007.sol: Let the speed of the swimmer be x m/s in and the current is y m/s respectively The swimmer started from P and swam 360 seconds to R against the current, then return to Q swimming for 360 seconds. PR = 360[x – y] ....{1} QR = 360[x + y] ....{2} PQ = QR – PR {From 1 and 2} ⇒ 120 = 360[x + y - x + y] ⇒ y = [IMG] m/s The speed of the current = [IMG] m/s = [IMG] × [IMG] = 0.6 km/hr

p75mock007.en: A cyclic quadrilateral ABCD is drawn in a circle with centre O. A and Care joined to O. If [IMG] ABC = 2p and [IMG] ADC = 3p, what is the measure [in degrees] of the [IMG] AOC reflex?

p75mock008.en: A is chasing B. A jumps 8 times, while B jumps 6 times in the same interval of time . But the distance covered by A in 7 jumps is the same as that of B in 5 jumps. The ratio between the speeds of A and B is ______________.
p75mock008.hi: A, B का पीछा कर रहा है। समान समय अंतराल में A, 8 छलांग लगाता है, जबकि B, 6 छलांग लगाता है । लेकिन A द्वारा 7 छलांगों में तय की गई दूरी B द्वारा 5 छलांगों में तय की गई दूरी के बराबर है। A और B की गति के बीच का अनुपात ______________ है।
p75mock008.sol: 7 jumps of A = 5 jumps of B A jumps 8 times, while B jumps 6 times. Jumps of A = [IMG] × 8 of the B A = [IMG] of B The ratio is [IMG] : 6 = 20 : 21

p75mock008.en: A triangle and a parallelogram have the same base 28 cm and the same area. If the height of the parallelogram is 12 cm, then find the length of the altitude of the triangle.
p75mock008.hi: एक त्रिभुज और एक समांतर चतुर्भुज का आधार 28 सेमी है और क्षेत्रफल भी समान है। यदि समांतर चतुर्भुज की ऊंचाई 12 सेमी है , तो त्रिभुज की ऊंचाई की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
p75mock008.sol: Given that, Area of triangle = Area of Parallelogram ⇒ [IMG] × 28 × h =28 ×12 ⇒ h = 24cm

p75mock008.en: A right circular cone has a radius of 16 cm and height of 30 cm. A sphere is placed inside the cone such that it touches the base and the slanted surface of the cone. Find the radius of this inscribed sphere.
p75mock008.hi: एक लंब वृत्तीय शंकु की त्रिज्या 16 cm और ऊँचाई 30 cm है। इस शंकु के अंदर एक गोला इस प्रकार रखा गया है कि वह शंकु के आधार और तिर्यक पृष्ठ को स्पर्श करता है। इस अंतर्निहित गोले की त्रिज्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
p75mock008.sol: For a sphere touching the base and the slanted surface of right circular cone, we use formula: γ=(R×h)/(R+l) γ=(16×30)/(16+34) γ=480/50=9.6cm. R, Radius =16cm H, height =30cm l, slant height =√(16²+30²) =34cm
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 139. 27 + 39 + 73 = (27 + 73) + 39 = 100 + 39 = 139

p75mock008.en: Nidhi scores 62 marks in Mathematics, 70 in English, 74 in Science. What should be her score in Social Science so that she gets an overall 68%?

p75mock008.sol: Let max marks of each subject is 100 Maths = 62 English = 70 Science = 74 Social Science = x Overall = 68% means = [IMG] ×100=68 206+x=272 x=66 marks

p75mock008.en: A loan of ₹8,925 is to be paid back in two equal half-yearly instalments. How much is each instalment if the interest is compounded half-yearly at 8%per annum?
p75mock008.hi: ₹8,925 का ऋण दो बराबर अर्ध-वार्षिक किस्तों में चुकाया जाना है। यदि चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज 8% प्रति वर्ष की दर से अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है, तो प्रत्येक किस्त कितनी होगी?

p75mock008.hi: ₹2000 की राशि साधारण ब्याज की एक योजना में निवेश करने पर ₹ 5920 हो जाती है। यदि ब्याज की वार्षिक दर और निवेश किए गए वर्षों की संख्या समान है , तो ब्याज की वार्षिक दर क्या है ?
p75mock008.sol: A.T.Q; 5920 – 2000 = [IMG] [IMG] = r 2 r 2 = 196 => r = 14% Hence option D is correct.

p75mock008.en: The side of a regular octagon is half the side of a regular quadrilateral (square). If the perimeter of the quadrilateral is 20 cm, what is the perimeter of the octagon?
p75mock008.hi: एक सम - अष्टभुज की भुजा , एक सम - चतुर्भुज ( वर्ग ) की भुजा की आधी होती है। यदि चतुर्भुज का परिमाप 20 cm है , तो अष्टभुज का परिमाप क्या होगा ?
p75mock008.sol: Perimeter of square = 4 × side ATQ, 4 × side = 20 Side = 5 cm Side of Octagon = 5cm/2 = 2.5 cm Perimeter of Octagon = 8 × 2.5 = 20 cm

p75mock008.en: A tower stands vertically on the ground. From point P, which is located 50 meters from the ground at the base of the tower, the angle of elevation to the tower’s top is α where tan(α) equals to 2. From another point Q, situated 100 meters away from the foot of the tower (in line with point P and the tower’s base), the angles of elevation to the top of tower is β. What is the value of tan(β)?
p75mock008.hi: ज़मीन पर एक टावर सीधा खड़ा है। पॉइंट P से , जो टावर के आधार से 50 मीटर की दूरी पर ज़मीन पर स्थित है , टावर के शिखर का उन्नयन कोण α है , जहाँ tan(α) का मान 2 है। एक अन्य पॉइंट Q से , जो टावर के आधार से 100 मीटर की दूरी पर स्थित है ( पॉइंट P और टावर के आधार की सीध में ), टावर के शिखर का उन्नयन कोण β है। tan(β) का मान क्या है ?
p75mock008.sol: [IMG] (h) Height of tower / (50 m) = tan α h = 100 m tan β = h/(100 m) = (100 m)/(100 m) = 1
[IMG]

p75mock008.en: Two trains - A and B having the lengths 195 m and 165 m, respectively, are running in the same direction on parallel lines. If the speed of A and B be 77 km/h and 85 km/h, respectively, what will be the time [in seconds] taken by them to cross each other?
p75mock008.hi: दो रेलगाड़ियाँ - A और B जिनकी लम्बाई क्रमशः 195 मीटर और 165 मीटर है , समान्तर रेखाओं पर एक ही दिशा में चल रही हैं। यदि A और B की गति क्रमशः 77 किमी / घंटा और 85 किमी / घंटा है , तो उन्हें एक दूसरे को पार करने में कितना समय [ सेकंड में ] लगेगा ?
p75mock008.sol: Relative speed will be= [85 km/h - 77 km/h] = 8 km/h or 8 × [IMG] = ( [IMG] ) m/s Total distance = 195 m + 165 m = 360 m, ⇒ Time = Distance/Speed ⇒ Time = [IMG] ⇒ Time = 18 × 9 = 162 sec

p75mock008.en: In a manufacturing unit. What percentage of the consumption of raw material be reduced to keep the cost the same as that before the increase?
p75mock008.hi: एक विनिर्माण इकाई में यह देखा गया कि कच्चे माल की कीमत में 25% की वृद्धि हुई है और श्रम लागत कच्चे माल की लागत के 30% से बढ़कर 38% हो गई है। लागत को वृद्धि से पहले के समान रखने के लिए कच्चे माल की खपत में कितने प्रतिशत की कमी की जानी चाहिए ?

p75mock008.en: The sum of the length, breadth and height of a cuboid box is 20 cm and the total surface area of cuboid is 256 sq. cm. What is the maximum length [in approximate] of a stick that can be placed inside the cuboid box? एक घनाभ बॉक्स की लंबाई , चौड़ाई और ऊंचाई का योग 20 सेमी है और घनाभ का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 256 वर्ग सेमी है। घनाभ बॉक्स के अंदर रखी जा सकने वाली छड़ी की अधिकतम लंबाई [ लगभग ] क्या है ?
p75mock008.hi: एक घनाभ बॉक्स की लंबाई , चौड़ाई और ऊंचाई का योग 20 सेमी है और घनाभ का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 256 वर्ग सेमी है। घनाभ बॉक्स के अंदर रखी जा सकने वाली छड़ी की अधिकतम लंबाई [ लगभग ] क्या है ?
p75mock008.sol: Given, l + b + h = 20cm TSA of cuboid = 2[lb + bh + hl] = 256 cm² Maximum length is a diagonal of cuboid: Diagonal of cuboid = [IMG] [l + b + h] 2 = l 2 + b 2 + h 2 + 2[lb + bh + hl] 20 2 = l 2 + b 2 + h 2 +256 l 2 + b 2 +h 2 =144 [IMG] = [IMG] = 12cm

p75mock008.en: A bookseller sells a novel for ₹Y and makes a loss of 12%. To clear old stock, he decides to mark the novel at 0.75Y. He then allows a further discount of 8% on this marked price. What will be the percentage loss that he will incur on this clearance sale?

p75mock008.sol: [IMG]

p75mock008.hi: समरीन एक कीबोर्ड 25% लाभ पर ₹ 1,260 में बेचती है , और दूसरा कीबोर्ड 10% हानि पर ₹ 1,440 में बेचती है। उसका कुल लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत क्या है ?

p75mock009.en: A trader bought 360 kg of rice, part at ₹20 per kg and the rest at ₹28 per kg. He sold the entire quantity at ₹32 per kg and made a total profit of ₹8,640. If the quantity bought at ₹20 per kg was twice the quantity bought at ₹28 per kg, find the quantity bought at ₹28 per kg.
p75mock009.hi: एक व्यापारी ने कुल 360 किलोग्राम चावल खरीदा , जिसमें कुछ ₹20 प्रति किलोग्राम और बाकी ₹28 प्रति किलोग्राम में खरीदे गए । उसने पूरी मात्रा को ₹32 प्रति किलोग्राम की दर से बेचा और कुल ₹8,640 का लाभ कमाया । यदि ₹20 प्रति किलोग्राम की दर से खरीदी गई मात्रा , ₹28 प्रति किलोग्राम की दर से खरीदी गई मात्रा का दो गुना थी , तो ₹28 प्रति किलोग्राम की दर से खरीदी गई मात्रा कितनी थी , यह ज्ञात कीजिए ।

p75mock009.en: A sold an article to B at a profit of 25%. B sold it to C at a profit of 15%. The profit made by B is Rs. 40 less than the profit made by A What is the cost price [in ₹] of the article for A?

p75mock009.en: In a circle, chord AB and chord CD intersect each other at E such that AE : EB=2:3 and CE : ED=5:2. If AB=x and CD=y, which of the following is correct?
p75mock009.hi: एक वृत्त में , जीवा AB और जीवा CD एक - दूसरे को बिंदु E पर इस प्रकार काटती हैं कि AE : EB = 2 : 3 और CE : ED = 5 : 2 है। यदि AB = x और CD = y हो , तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन - सा कथन सही है ?
p75mock009.sol: [IMG] By Using Property AE × EB = CE × ED AB = 5 unit = N AE = 2 unit = 2x/5 EB = 3 unit = 3x/5 CD = 7 unit = y CE = 5 unit = 5y/7 ED = 2 unit = 2y/7 Putting these values: (2x/5) × (3x/5) = (5y/7) × (2y/7) x²/y² = 125/147

p75mock009.en: In a bank, 6% interest is given on the deposited amount. The bank then invests the money in the stock market and is able to earn ₹30,000 for every ₹3,00,000. How much money is the bank earning finally if the total amount deposited in the bank is ₹60,00,000?
p75mock009.hi: एक बैंक में जमा राशि पर 6% ब्याज दिया जाता है। बैंक फिर उस पैसे को शेयर बाजार में निवेश करता है और हर ₹ 3,00,000 पर ₹ 30,000 कमा पाता है। अगर बैंक में जमा कुल राशि ₹ 60,00,000 है तो बैंक आखिर में कितना पैसा कमा रहा है ?
p75mock009.sol: Total Interest given by Bank = [IMG] =3,60,000 Earnings of Bank from stock market = [IMG] ×60,00,000 = 6,00,000 ∴ Total Earnings of Bank = 6,00,000 [IMG] 3,60,000 = 2,40,000

p75mock009.hi: पूर्ण वर्ग संख्या प्राप्त करने के लिए 8212 में जोड़ी जाने वाली सबसे छोटी संख्या क्या है ?

p75mock009.en: A circle is entirely enclosed within a parallelogram such that all four sides of the parallelogram are tangent to the circle. What particular type of parallelogram must this be?
p75mock009.hi: एक वृत्त पूरी तरह से एक समांतर चतुर्भुज के भीतर इस प्रकार घिरा हुआ है कि समांतर चतुर्भुज की चारों भुजाएँ वृत्त को स्पर्श करती हैं। यह समांतर चतुर्भुज किस विशेष प्रकार का होना चाहिए ?
p75mock009.sol: A circle can be inscribed within a parallelogram (meaning it is tangent to all four sides) only if the parallelogram is a tangential quadrilateral. In tangential quadrilateral, sum of opposite sides are equal. [IMG] AB+CD= BC +DA CAB=CD and BC=DA opposite side of parallelogram are equal 2 (AB)=2(BC) ⇒ AB = BC Thus, a parallelogram with adjacent sides equal is a Rhombus.

p75mock009.sol: The number obtained by arranging 5702718 is descending order: 8775210 Subtract 4 more than three times of 17 = 8775210 – 55=8775155 8775155 is clearly divisible by 5.

p75mock010.en: In a [IMG] ABC, points P, Q and R are taken on AB, BC and CA, respectively, such that BQ = PQ and QC = QR. If [IMG] BAC = 75 ° . What is the measure of [IMG] PQR [in degrees]?
p75mock010.hi: [IMG] ABC में , AB, BC और CA पर क्रमशः P, Q और R बिंदु इस प्रकार लिए गए हैं कि BQ = PQ और QC = QR है। यदि [IMG] BAC = 75° है। [IMG] PQR का माप [ डिग्री में ] क्या है ?
p75mock010.sol: [IMG] Given the, ∠A = 75 ̊ BQ = PQ & QC = QR Let ∠PQR = x ̊ ∠ ABC = b ̊ & ∠ACB = c Then in ∠ABC 75 + b + c = 180 ̊ b + c = 105 ̊ Now; in ∠BPQ, b + b + ∠BQP = 180 ̊ ∠ BQP = 180 ̊ - 2b Similarly, ∠CQR =180 - 2C adding both; ∠ BQP + ∠CQR = 360 ̊ - 2[b + c] = 360 ̊ - 2[105 ̊ ] = 150 ̊ Now, ∠ BQP + ∠CQR + x ̊=180 ̊ [Same line] ∴ 150 ̊ + x =180 ̊ => x = 30 ̊ Short: Remember that ∠ PQR + 2∠BAC = 180 ̊ ∴∠ PQR + 2 × 75 ̊= 180 ̊ ∠ PQR = 30 ̊

p75mock010.sol: [IMG] th of distance =160 × [IMG] =128 km [IMG] rd of Time =15 × [IMG] =10h Remaining Distance =160 - 128 = 32 km Remaining Time =15 - 10 = 5l Required speed = [IMG] = 6.4 km/h

p75mock010.en: Five men can complete a work in 20 days. Ten women can complete the same work in 15 days. Two men and six women started working together. After 5 days, three women left the work and a new man joined the work. The group continued working together till the end of the work. In how many days will they be able to do the remaining work?
p75mock010.hi: पाँच पुरुष एक काम को 20 दिन में पूरा कर सकते हैं। दस महिलाएँ उसी काम को 15 दिन में पूरा कर सकती हैं। दो पुरुष और छह महिलाएँ एक साथ काम करना शुरू करते हैं। 5 दिन बाद , तीन महिलाएँ काम छोड़कर चली जाती हैं और एक नया पुरुष काम में शामिल हो जाता है। समूह काम के अंत तक एक साथ काम करता रहा। वे बचे हुए काम को कितने दिनों में पूरा कर पाएँगे ?
p75mock010.sol: 5m × 20 = 10w × 15 m : w = 3 : 2 Total work = 5 × 3 × 20 = 300 =Work done in 5 days = [2m + 6w] × 5 = [6 + 12] ×5 = 90 = work left = 300 [IMG] 90 =210 Let remaining work will be done in ‘n’ days then [3w + 3m] × n ⇒ 210 n =14 days

p75mock011.sol: Avg of 11 numbers =54 Avg of first 4 Nos =48 Avg of Next 4Nos = 48× [IMG] = 60 ∴ Sum of last 3 Nos. =11×54 - 4×48 - 4×60 =594 - 4[108] = 162 Let the 11 th Number = x Then A.T.Q; x+8+x+4+x =162 3x =150⇒ x =50 ∴ Avg of 9 th and 10 th = [IMG] = [IMG] =56

p75mock012.sol: [IMG] PM = 13 by Pythagoras RN =17 by Pythagoras PR = PM + MN + NR =13 + 5 + 8 + 17 = 43

p75mock012.sol: F [IMG] n = S—{i} F = 4[S [IMG] n]—{ii} F + S =130—{iii} From {i} & {ii} S + n = 4S - 4n 3S = 5n [IMG] = [IMG] let S = 5x & n = 3x From {ii} & {iii] F + S=130 S + n + S =130 2S + n =130 →2 × 5x + 3x =130 13x =130 X =10 Now son’s age = 5x =50 Father age F + 50=130 F = 80 Difference = 80 - 50 = 30yrs.

p75mock013.sol: LCM of 3,7 and 11 = 231 Take largest value of x & y i.e. 9 & [and divide the number by 231 and work on remainder] 247xy =24799 = 231×107 + 82 Remainder = 82 24799 would have been 82 less then number will be divisible by 231. So, 24799 -82 = 24717 247xy = 24717 x=1 and y = 7 The value of [2y - 8x] = 2×7 - 8×1 = 6

p75mock013.en: An iron triangle has a base 10 cm, height 12 cm. If the density is 7.8 g/cm 3 and thickness is 2 cm, find the mass.
p75mock013.hi: एक लोहे के त्रिभुज का आधार 10 cm और ऊँचाई 12 cm है। यदि इसका घनत्व 7.8 g/cm³ और मोटाई 2 cm है , तो इसका द्रव्यमान ज्ञात कीजिए।
p75mock013.sol: Let the required mass be 'n'. Density =Mass/Volume ATQ; 7.8g/cm³=n/(Area × Thickness) Area of triangle = (1/2) × Base × Height = (1/2) × 10 × 12 = 60 cm² Thickness = 2 cm (given) Now, 7.8g/cm³=n/(60 × 2 cm³) n = 936 gram

p75mock014.en: Two trains, running between Bangalore and Chennai, start at the same time from their respective locations and proceed towards each other at the speed of 80km/h and 95km/h. When they meet, it is found that one train has travelled 180km more than the other. The distance between Bangalore and Chennai is _____________.
p75mock014.hi: बैंगलोर और चेन्नई के बीच चलने वाली दो ट्रेनें एक ही समय पर अपने - अपने स्थानों से चलना शुरू करती हैं और 80 किमी / घंटा और 95 किमी / घंटा की गति से एक - दूसरे की ओर बढ़ती हैं। जब वे मिलती हैं , तो पाया जाता है कि एक ट्रेन ने दूसरी से 180 किमी अधिक यात्रा की है। बैंगलोर और चेन्नई के बीच की दूरी _____________ है।
p75mock014.sol: L et the time of travelling be’t’ hours Distance travelled by train with speed 80 km/h in t hours = 80t Distance travelled by train with speed 95 km/h in t hours = 95t Difference in distance travelled by two train = 95 t - 80t = 180 ⇒ 15t = 180 ⇒ t = 12 hours Distance between stations = 80 ×12 + 95 × 12 = 960 + 1140 = 2100km

p75mock014.en: A large solid cube is melted and cast into 'N' small solid spheres, each of radius 3 cm, and 'N + 2' small solid cuboids, each of dimensions 4 cm × 4 cm × 6.5 cm. If the length of each side of the large solid cube is 12 cm, then find the value 'N'. [Use [IMG] = 22/7] ?
p75mock014.hi: एक बड़े ठोस घन को पिघलाकर 'N' छोटे ठोस गोले बनाए गए हैं , जिनमें से प्रत्येक की त्रिज्या 3 सेमी है , और 'N + 2' छोटे ठोस घनाभ बनाए गए हैं , जिनमें से प्रत्येक का आयाम 4 सेमी × 4 सेमी × 6.5 सेमी है। यदि बड़े ठोस घन की प्रत्येक भुजा की लंबाई 12 सेमी है , तो 'N' का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [ [IMG] = 22/7 का प्रयोग करें ] ?
p75mock014.sol: Volume of cube = a³ Volume of large cube = 12³ =1728 cm³ Volume of sphere = [IMG] π r³ = [IMG] π × 3³ = 36 π cm³ Volume of cuboid = l × b × h = 4 × 4 × 6.5 = 104 cm³ Volume of [N + 2]cuboid = [N + 2] ×104 Total volume after melting: V of cube = V of sphere + V of cuboids 1728 = N × 36 π + 104 [N + 2] N = 7

p75mock014.en: A high-end watch is initially marked up by 40% above its cost price. During a sale, it is offered at a 20% discount on its marked price. However, a special customer receives a special discount of 25% on the discounted price, bringing the final selling price to ₹63,000. what was the original cost price and the difference between both the discount?
p75mock014.hi: एक हाई - एंड घड़ी की प्रारंभिक कीमत उसकी लागत मूल्य से 40% अधिक अंकित की गई थी । सेल के दौरान इसे उसके अंकित मूल्य पर 20% की छूट के साथ पेश किया गया । हालांकि , एक विशेष ग्राहक को इस छूट के बाद मूल्य पर 25% की अतिरिक्त विशेष छूट मिली , जिससे अंतिम विक्रय मूल्य ₹63,000 हुआ । प्रारंभिक लागत मूल्य क्या थी और दोनों छूटों के बीच का अंतर कितना था ?
p75mock014.sol: Let original Cost Price = ₹x Marked Price (MP) = 40% above CP MP = 1.4x First discount = 20% on MP Price after first discount = 1.4x × 0.8 = 1.12x Second discount = 25% on discounted price Final Selling Price (SP) = 1.12x × 0.75 = 0.84x Given, Final SP = ₹63,000 So, 0.84x = 63,000 x = 63,000 / 0.84 x = 75,000 Original Cost Price = ₹75,000 Now find both discounts in rupees Marked Price = 1.4 × 75,000 = ₹1,05,000 First discount (20% of 1,05,000) = 21,000 Price after first discount = 1,05,000 − 21,000 = ₹84,000 Second discount (25% of 84,000) = 21,000 Difference between both discounts = 21,000 − 21,000 = ₹0

p75mock018.en: In ∆ABC, D and E are mid points of sides BC and AC, respectively. If AD = 10.8 cm, BE = 14.4 cm and AD and BE intersect at Gat a right angle, then the area [in [IMG] ] of ∆AВС is:
p75mock018.hi: ∆ABC में , D और E क्रमशः BC और AC भुजाओं के मध्य बिंदु हैं। यदि AD = 10.8 सेमी , BE = 14.4 सेमी और AD और BE एक दूसरे को G पर समकोण पर प्रतिच्छेद करते हैं , तो ∆ A ВС का क्षेत्रफल [ in [IMG] ] है :
p75mock018.sol: [IMG] Since AD and BE are the medians of △ABC and median divides in 2 : 1 So, AG = 10.8 × [IMG] =7.2 And BG = [IMG] ×2 = 9.6 Area △AGB= [IMG] × AG × BG = [IMG] × 7.2 × 9.6 = 34.56 In ∆AGB = area of ∆AGF + ∆BGF Area of ∆ABC = 3 × area △AGB = 3 × 34.56 = 103.68 cm 2 [IMG] चूँकि AD और BE, △ ABC की माध्यिकाएँ हैं और माध्यिका 2 : 1 में विभाजित होती है अतः , AG = 10.8 × [IMG] =7.2 और BG = [IMG] ×2 = 9.6 क्षेत्रफल △ AGB= [IMG] × AG × BG = [IMG] × 7.2 × 9.6 = 34.56 ∆ AGB में = ∆AGF का क्षेत्रफल + ∆BGF ∆ ABC का क्षेत्रफल = 3 × क्षेत्रफल △ AGB = 3 × 34.56 = 103.68 cm 2

p75mock018.en: The numbers 24, 45, a, 35, 59, 83, 46, b, 29, 74 are serially numbered as they appear in the sequence. When each number is added to its serial number, then the average of the new numbers formed is 55. The average of the missing numbers [a and b] is:
p75mock018.hi: संख्याएँ 24, 45, a, 35, 59, 83, 46, b, 29, 74 क्रमानुसार क्रमांकित हैं जैसा कि वे क्रम में दिखाई देती हैं। जब प्रत्येक संख्या को उसके क्रम संख्या में जोड़ा जाता है , तो बनने वाली नई संख्याओं का औसत 55 होता है। लुप्त संख्याओं [ a और b] का औसत है :
p75mock018.sol: Sum of all the numbers i.e. 24+45+a+35+59+83+46+b+29+74 =395+[a+b] Now; when each number added to its serial number, New sum is, 395+[a+b]+[1+2+3+4⋯+10] = 395+[a+b]+ [IMG] = 450+[a+b] According to question; 450+[a+b]=55×10 = 550 a+b =550 - 450=100 Avg= [IMG] = [IMG] =50

p75mock018.en: The unequal side of an isosceles triangle is 2 cm. The medians drawn to the equal sides are perpendicular. The area of the triangle is:

p75mock019.sol: The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 77.37 . \(\sqrt{5929+58}\) a = 5929, b = 58 Square root = \(\sqrt a + \frac{b}{2\sqrt a}\) = \(\sqrt {5929} + \frac{58}{2\sqrt {5929}}\) = 77 + 29/77 = 77.37

p75mock019.en: A water tank is shaped like a composite prism: the bottom part is a triangular prism with base area 100cm^2and height 1.4 m , while the top part is a rectangular prism with base 60 cm x 25 cm and height 0.9 m. what is the total volume of the tank in litres? (1m 3 =1000L)

p75mock019.sol: Volume of triangular prism = Base Area × Height =100×140 (∵1.4m=140cm) =14000cm³ Volume of rectangular prism = Base Area × Height =60×25×90cm³ =135000cm³ Total volume =14000+135000cm³ =149000cm³ 1L=1000cm³ ⇒149000/1000=149 litres
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 40. 11 + 29 = (10 + 1) + (30 – 1) = 10 + 30 = 40

p75mock019.en: In a factory with 400 employees, the ratio of the number of male employees to that of female employees is 5: 3. There are 87.5% regular employees in the factory. If 92% of male employees are regular employees, then what is the percentage of regular female employees?

p75mock019.sol: Male-250, Female-150 Regular employees- 400*7/8=350 Male employees regular- 250*92%=230 Regular female=350-230=120 120/150 *100=80% x=87.5-7.5=80 Alternate Method : Total regular employee = 87.5% of 400 = 350 Total male & female = [IMG] = 50 Male =250 [50×5] Female =150 [50×3] Total male regular employee = [IMG] ×250=230 The percentage of regular female employee = [IMG] ×100=80%

p75mock021.en: If the interior angle of a regular polygon is k times its exterior angle, express the number of sides (n) of the polygon in terms of k.

p75mock021.sol: Let the exterior angle = x Interior angle = Kx Interior + Exterior = 180° x(K+1)=180° Exterior angle =x=180/(K+1) Also Exterior angle = (360°)/x(n: number of side) (180°)/(K+1)=(360°)/x=n=2(K+1) = 2K + 2
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 27 . [IMG]

p75mock023.en: [IMG] PQR is inscribed in a circle with center O. PO is produced to meet QR at U and the circle at S, and PT [IMG] QR, where T lies between Q and U. If [IMG] Q = 70° and [IMG] R = 55°, then what is the measure [in degrees] of [IMG] TPS?
p75mock023.hi: [IMG] PQR को केंद्र O वाले एक वृत्त में अंकित किया गया है। PO को QR से U पर तथा वृत्त को S पर मिलाने के लिए बढ़ाया गया है , तथा PT [IMG] QR है , जहाँ T, Q और U के बीच में स्थित है। यदि [IMG] Q = 70° और [IMG] R = 55° है , तो [IMG] TPS का माप [ डिग्री में ] क्या है ?
p75mock023.sol: [IMG] Given that PT ⊥ QR ∠ Q = 70 ̊, ∠R = 55 ̊ O is the centre of circle Then; with formula ∠ TPS = ∠Q - ∠R =70 – 55 = 15 ̊ 2nd method: [In detail] In △PQR, ∠Q = 70, ∠R = 55 ̊ Hen ∠P = 180 – 70 – 55 = 55 ̊ And, in △PQT, ∠T= 90 ̊, ∠Q = 70 ̊ Hen ∠QPT=180 – 90 – 70 = 20 ̊ Now, join SR to form △PRS Where, ∠PRS = 90 ̊ [semicircle] ∠ PSR =∠PQR [same arc] ∴∠ RPS = 90 – 70 = 20 ̊ Now; ∠ TPS = ∠QPR [IMG] ∠RPS [IMG] ∠QPT = 55 – 20 – 20 = 15 ̊

p75mock023.sol: Speed of X = 6 km and speed of Y = 8 km Speed ratio of X and Y = 6 : 8 = 3 : 4 Time ratio of X and Y = 4 : 3 The time difference = 15 min + 10 min = 25 min 4x – 3x = x x = 25 min Time taking by X = 4 × 25 = 100 min = 100/60 hr Distance covered by X in [IMG] hr = [IMG] × 6 = 10 km.

p75mock024.sol: [IMG] In 2 days work done =(4-3)=1 unit (×56 )×56 112 days work done =56 unit on 113 th day =4 unit work will be done by Aman. Total time taken to do the work=113 days

p75mock024.en: The speed of a boat downstream is 2.5 times the speed of the boat upstream. If the time taken by the boat for going 30 km downstream and the same distance upstream is 7 hours, then what is the speed [in km/h] of the boat downstream?

p75mock024.sol: Speed→ Upstream: Downstream = 1 : 2.5 = 2 : 5 Acc. to question: [IMG] + [IMG] =7 [IMG] = 7, x = [IMG] Speed of Boat in downstream = 5 × 3 = 15km/h

p75mock024.en: Pipes A, B and C can fil a tank in 15, 30 and 40 hours respectively. Pipes A, B and C are ореnеd at 6 a.m,8 a.m. and 10 a.m., respectively, on the same day. When will the tank be full?

p75mock024.en: If a nine-digit number 985x3678y is divisible by 72, then the value of {4x-3y} is:
p75mock024.hi: यदि नौ अंकों की संख्या 985x3678y, 72 से विभाज्य है , तो {4x-3y} का मान क्या है ?
p75mock024.sol: If number is divisible by 72 then it must be divisible by 8 and 9. Divisibility of 8: The last 3 digit of number must be divisible by 8. Divisibility of 9: The sum of all digits of the number must be divisible by 9. 9+8+5+x+3+6+7+8+y = 46+x+y x+y = 8,17 26→not possible as x, y ≤ 9 78y must be divisible by 8 So, y = 4 x+y = 8 x= 8-4 = 4 4x-3y = 4×4-3×4 = 4
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 91.97 . \(\sqrt{8281+177}\) a = 8281, b = 177 Square root = \(\sqrt a + \frac{b}{2\sqrt a}\) = \(\sqrt {8281} + \frac{177}{2\sqrt {8281}}\) = 91 + 0.97 = 91.97
p75mock024.chap: Square root of 2 3 and 4 digit numbers

p75mock024.sol: [IMG] ⇒ LZ × ZM = kZ × ZJ ⇒ LZ × 33 = 12 × 22 ⇒ LZ = 8cm.

p75mock024.en: The bathroom floor measurers 4 m in length and 1.2 m in width. One of its walls which is also to be tiled fully, measures 2.5 m in length and 3 m in height. If square tiles of side 30 cm are used, and an extra 10 % of tiles are purchased to cover cuts and wastage, how many tiles are needed in total?
p75mock024.hi: बाथरूम के फ़र्श की लंबाई 4 m और चौड़ाई 1.2 m है। इसकी एक दीवार , जिस पर पूरी तरह से टाइलें लगानी हैं , की लंबाई 2.5 m और ऊँचाई 3 m है। यदि 30 cm भुजा वाली वर्गाकार टाइलें इस्तेमाल की जाती हैं , और कटाई व बर्बादी को ध्यान में रखते हुए 10% अतिरिक्त टाइलें खरीदी जाती हैं , तो कुल कितनी टाइलों की आवश्यकता होगी ?
p75mock024.sol: Area of bathroom floor =4m×1.2m =4.8m² Area of wall =2.5m×3m =7.5m² Total area to be tiled =4.8+7.5m² =12.3m² Area of one tile = (side)²= (0.3m)² =0.09m² Tiles required without wastage=12.3/0.09 =137 (approx.) Now, an extra of 10% is needed =10% of 137 =13.7 Total tiles needed =137+13.7 =151 tiles (approx)
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 126. 95 + 31 = 126

Also, while Peter invested for 2 years, Rachel invested for 3 years. If the difference in the interest earned by Peter and Rachel was ₹897, what was the sum that Rachel had invested?
p75mock025.hi: पीटर ने एक निश्चित राशि 10% प्रति वर्ष साधारण ब्याज देने वाली योजना में निवेश की , जबकि रेचल ने पीटर द्वारा निवेश की गई राशि का आधा हिस्सा 10% प्रति वर्ष चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज देने वाली योजना में निवेश किया। साथ ही , जबकि पीटर ने 2 साल के लिए निवेश किया , रेचल ने 3 साल के लिए निवेश किया। यदि पीटर और रेचल द्वारा अर्जित ब्याज में अंतर ₹ 897 था , तो रेचल ने कितनी राशि निवेश की थी ?

The total cost of the items is ₹18,00,000 and the marked price is 12% more than the cost price. If he finally earns neither profit nor loss, find the value of x.
p75mock025.hi: सामान का स्टॉक खाली करने के लिए , एक विक्रेता अंकित मूल्य पर 10% की छूट देता है । वह इस छूट ऑफ़र के प्रचार पर ₹x खर्च करता है । सामान की कुल लागत ₹18,00,000 है और अंकित मूल्य लागत मूल्य से 12% अधिक है । यदि अंततः उसे न तो लाभ होता है और न हानि , तो x की राशि ज्ञात कीजिए ।
p75mock025.sol: CP= 18,00,000 MP = 112/100 × CP Disc = 10%; SP = 9/10 × 112/100 × CP No profit or Loss after promo cost “x” 9/10 × 112/100 × CP - x = CP → x = ₹ 14,400

p75mock025.en: By selling an article for ₹390, a shopkeeper suffers some loss. Had he sold it for ₹444, he would have earned a profit equal to one-fifth of the loss he had in the earlier case. If he sells it for ₹522, what will be his profit percentage?

p75mock025.en: In a quadrilateral ABCD, a line segment BD is a diagonal such that AB=CD and ∠ABD=∠CDB. Are the triangles ABD and CDB congruent? If so, then by what rule?

p75mock025.sol: [IMG] AB = CD (Given) ∠ ABD = ∠ CDB BD = BD (common) By S.A.S Rule ∆ ABD ≅ ∆CDB

p75mock025.en: Varun and Madhur invested ₹25,000 each in different schemes, Varun earned simple interest at 11% per annum, whereas Madhur earned compound interest at 10% per annum compounds. Who received more interest after 2 years and how much?
p75mock025.hi: वरुण और मधुर ने अलग - अलग योजनाओं में ₹ 25,000 निवेश किए , वरुण ने 11% प्रति वर्ष की दर से साधारण ब्याज अर्जित किया , जबकि मधुर ने 10% प्रति वर्ष की दर से चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज अर्जित किया। 2 वर्ष बाद किसे अधिक ब्याज मिला और कितना ?
p75mock025.sol: Rate for Varun , 2 years at 11% on Simple interest = 22% And Net rate for Madhur, 2 years at 10% on Compound interest = 21% Difference in interest = 22-21=1% ⇒ 25,000 ×1% = ₹250 Varun earned ₹250 more.

p75mock026.sol: Minimum Passing =60% of 150=90 G.K =60% of 30=18 Reasoning =55% of 60=33 English =25% of 60=15 Total correct =18+33+15=66 Required =90-66=24

If it takes 40 hours to fill the tank when all the three pipes opened simultaneously, in what time [in hours] will pipe C empty the full tank operating alone?

p75mock028.sol: Time ratio: A : B = 4 : 5 & [A+B] : [A+B-C] = 5 : 9 Eff. Ratio: A : B = 5 : 4 & [A+B] : [A+B-C] = 9 : 5 With above equation, eff. Of A = 5, B = 4 and C = -4 TW = 40×5 = 200 Time taken by C to empty = 200/4 = 50 hrs.

p75mock029.en: The ratio of gold to copper in a bracelet is 5 : 8. If the price of copper is 1/8th the price of gold, find the cost (in ₹) of the bracelet if the cost of copper in the bracelet is ₹32,000.
p75mock029.hi: एक कंगन में सोना और ताँबा का अनुपात 5 : 8 है। यदि ताँबे का मूल्य, सोने के मूल्य का 1/8 है, तो उस कंगन की कुल लागत (₹ में) ज्ञात कीजिए, जब कंगन में प्रयुक्त ताँबे की लागत ₹32,000 है।

p75mock029.en: PQ and RS are common tangents to two circles intersecting at A and B. AB, when produced on both the sides, meet the tangents PQ and RS at X and Y, respectively. If AB = 3 cm and XY = 5 cm, then PQ is.
p75mock029.hi: PQ और RS दो वृत्तों की उभयनिष्ठ स्पर्श रेखाएँ हैं जो A और B पर प्रतिच्छेद करती हैं। AB को जब दोनों ओर बढ़ाया जाता है , तो स्पर्श रेखाएँ PQ और RS क्रमशः X और Y पर मिलती हैं। यदि AB = 3 सेमी और XY = 5 सेमी है , तो PQ है।
p75mock029.sol: [IMG] XY = 5 & AB = 3 ⇒ XA =1=BY Now, PX 2 = XA × XB = 1 × 4 PX = 2 Similarly XQ = 2 ∴ PQ = 2 + 2 = 4

p75mock029.en: A can complete a piece of work in 25 days while B can complete the same work in 30 days. They work on alternate basis, starting with A. Both A and B follow this pattern for 5 days and then A leaves the work. In how many days will B finish the remaining work?
p75mock029.hi: A किसी काम को 25 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है जबकि B उसी काम को 30 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। वे A से शुरू करके बारी - बारी से काम करते हैं। A और B दोनों 5 दिनों तक इस पैटर्न का पालन करते हैं और फिर A काम छोड़ देता है। B शेष काम कितने दिनों में पूरा करेगा ?
p75mock029.sol: [IMG] Work done by A and B together in 2 days →11 5 days → 22 + 6 =28 Work left =150 [IMG] 28=122 Time taken by B to complete the remaining work = [IMG] = [IMG] days [IMG] A और B द्वारा 2 दिन में किया गया कार्य → 11 5 दिन → 22 + 6 =28 शेष कार्य = 150 - 28=122 शेष कार्य पूरा करने में B द्वारा लिया गया समय = [IMG] = [IMG] दिन
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 28 . 4 × 7 = 28

p75mock029.sol: T ime taken by P to cover the circular track = [IMG] = 12 hrs ⇒ Time taken by Q to cover the circular track = [IMG] = 9 hrs ⇒ Time taken by R to cover the circular track = [IMG] = 6 hrs ⇒ LCM of 12, 9 and 6 = 36

p75mock030.en: Two pipes, A and B, can fill a tank in 10 minutes and 20 minutes, respectively. The pipe C can empty the tank in 30 minutes. All the three pipes are opened at a time in the beginning. However, pipe C is closed 2 minutes before the tank is filled. In what time, will the tank be full [in minutes]?
p75mock030.hi: दो पाइप , A और B, एक टैंक को क्रमशः 10 मिनट और 20 मिनट में भर सकते हैं। पाइप C टैंक को 30 मिनट में खाली कर सकता है। शुरुआत में तीनों पाइप एक साथ खोले जाते हैं। हालाँकि , टैंक भरने से 2 मिनट पहले पाइप C को बंद कर दिया जाता है। कितने समय में टैंक भर जाएगा [ मिनटों में ] ?
p75mock030.sol: [IMG] Let the tank will be filled in ‘t’ minutes ⇒ Capacity = Time × Efficiency ⇒ [6 + 3] × t - 2[t - 2] = 60 ⇒ 9 × t - 2t + 4 = 60 ⇒ 7t = 56 ⇒ t = 8 minutes

p75mock030.en: If a 10-digit number 2094x843y2 is divisible by 88, then the value of [5x - 7y] for the largest possible value of x is:
p75mock030.hi: यदि 10 अंकों की संख्या 2094x843y2, 88 से विभाज्य है , तो x के सबसे बड़े संभावित मान के लिए [5x - 7y] का मान क्या है ?
p75mock030.sol: If number is divisible by 88 then it must be divisible by 8 and 11. Divisibility of 8: The last 3 digit of number must be divisible by 8. 3y2 must be divisible by 8 So, y = 1 y = 5 and y = 9 Divisibility of 11: if the difference between the sums of the alternate digits of the given number is either 0 or divisible by 11. 2094x843y2 2+9+x+4+y = 0+4+8+3+2 x+y -2 = 11 [x+y]-2 =11 Y=5 x=8 5x - 7y = 5×8-7×5 = 5
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 45.55 . \(\sqrt{2025 + 50}\) a = 2025, b = 50 Square root = \(\sqrt a + \frac{b}{2\sqrt a}\) = \(\sqrt {2025} + \frac{50}{2\sqrt {2025}}\) = 45 + 25/45 = 45.55

p75mock030.en: The speed of a car increases by 2 km/hr after every one hour. If the distance travelled in the first one hour was 35 km, what was the total distance travelled in 12 hours?
p75mock030.hi: एक कार की गति हर एक घंटे के बाद 2 किमी / घंटा बढ़ जाती है। यदि पहले एक घंटे में तय की गई दूरी 35 किमी थी , तो 12 घंटे में तय की गई कुल दूरी कितनी थी ?
p75mock030.sol: Distance travelled in the first one hour was 35 km, Distance travelled in 2 nd hour = 35 + 2 = 37 km Distance travelled by car in every hour will be in Arithmetic Progression. 35, 37, 39… up to 12 terms First term = a = 35, Common difference = d = 37 – 35 = 2, Number of terms = n = 12 Formula ∶ = [IMG] {2a + [n – 1]d} Total distance travelled in 12 hours = [IMG] {2 × 35 + [12 – 1]2} = 6[70 + 22] = 6 × 92 = 552 km

If the company wants to estimate the total cost of chocolate, knowing that 1cm 3 of chocolate costs ₹0.40, what is the cost of chocolate to fill one such box?
p75mock030.hi: एक कंपनी एक नया चॉकलेट बॉक्स डिज़ाइन करती है , जो एक नियमित समकोण पिरामिड के आकार का है और जिसका आधार वर्गाकार है। बॉक्स के आधार की भुजा 14 cm है ​​ और इसकी ऊँचाई 18 cm है। पैकेजिंग से जुड़ी सीमाओं के कारण , बॉक्स को उसकी कुल आयतन के केवल 80% तक ही भरा जा सकता है। यदि कंपनी चॉकलेट की कुल लागत का अनुमान लगाना चाहती है , यह जानते हुए कि 1 cm³ चॉकलेट की कीमत ₹ 0.40 है , तो ऐसे एक बॉक्स को भरने के लिए चॉकलेट की लागत कितनी होगी ?
p75mock030.sol: Volume of Square pyramid =1/3× Base Area × Height =1/3×(14cm)²×18 =1/3×196×18=1176cm³ But Box can be filled up to 80% of its total volume 4/5×1176cm³=940.8cm³ Cost of chocolate per cm³=₹0.40 Required cost =940.8×0.40 =₹376.32

p75mock030.sol: As per question; required amount to be paid after 2 yrs ⇒ 1,92,208×130%-20,196×115% ⇒ 249870.4-23225.4 ⇒ 226645Rs.

p75mock030.en: A circular decorative wall clock with a radius of 15 cm has a design where a chord connects two points on the circumference. Find the percentage of the clock’s total area that this smaller painted segment represents? (Use π=3.14, √3=1.732)

(π=3.14, √3=1.732 का इस्तेमाल करें )

p75mock030.en: A ladder is leaning against a wall makes an angle ‘x’ with the horizontal ground such that tanx=105/140. If the length of the ladder is 26 metres, then what is the distance (in metres) of the foot of the ladder from the wall?
p75mock030.hi: एक सीढ़ी दीवार के सहारे टिकी हुई है और ज़मीन के साथ ‘ x’ कोण बनाती है , इस तरह कि tanx = 105/140 है। यदि सीढ़ी की लंबाई 26 मीटर है , तो सीढ़ी के निचले सिरे से दीवार की दूरी ( मीटर में ) कितनी होगी ?
p75mock030.sol: [IMG] tan x = 105/140 = Perpendicular / Base = 3/4 (3,4,5) is a triplet Hypotenuse = 5 give 5 unit → 26 metres 1 unit → 5.2 metres Distance of foot of ladder from wall = 4 unit = 5.2 × 4 metres = 20.8 metres

p75mock030.en: A thief steals an item and escapes, running at 20 km/h. A policeman arrives at the spot of the crime after 6 minutes and immediately starts chasing the thief. 24 minutes after the policeman started to chase the thief; there is still a gap of 400 m between the two. At what distance from the spot of crime would the policeman catch up with the thief, and what is the speed at which the policeman ran?
p75mock030.hi: एक चोर एक वस्तु चुराता है और 20 किमी / घंटा की गति से भागता है। एक पुलिसकर्मी 6 मिनट के बाद अपराध स्थल पर पहुंचता है और तुरंत चोर का पीछा करना शुरू कर देता है। पुलिसकर्मी द्वारा चोर का पीछा शुरू करने के 24 मिनट बाद भी दोनों के बीच 400 मीटर का अंतर है। अपराध स्थल से कितनी दूरी पर पुलिसकर्मी चोर को पकड़ लेगा और पुलिसकर्मी किस गति से भागा ?
p75mock030.sol: Total time thief has been running when gap is 400m = 6 + 24. = 30min Distance covered by thief = 20 × [IMG] = 100km Distance covered by Policeman in 24 min =100km - [IMG] km = 9.6km Speed of policeman = [IMG] = 24km/h Relative speed =24 [IMG] 20 = 4km/h Time to cover 400m gap = [IMG] = [IMG] = 0.1hour = 0.1 × 60 = 6min Total distance from the spot of crime when the policeman catches the thief = 20 × [IMG] = 20 × [IMG] =12km

p75mock030.en: Mr. Stark gave 30% of the money he had to Bruce. He also gave 90% of the remaining amount to each of Natasha, Captain and Vision. Half of the remaining amount he spent on miscellaneous items, and the remaining amount of ₹14,000 he deposited in Marvel's Fund. How much did Mr. Stark initially have?
p75mock030.hi: मिस्टर स्टार्क ने अपने पास मौजूद पैसे का 30% ब्रूस को दे दिया। उन्होंने नताशा , कैप्टन और विजन में से प्रत्येक को शेष राशि का 90% भी दे दिया। शेष राशि का आधा हिस्सा उन्होंने विविध वस्तुओं पर खर्च किया , और शेष ₹ 14,000 को उन्होंने मार्वल के फंड में जमा कर दिया। शुरुआत में मिस्टर स्टार्क के पास कितना पैसा था ?
p75mock030.sol: Let total money is = 1000x Bruce get = 300x Remaining amount is 700x Natasha, Captain & Vision get = [IMG] = 630x Now remaining amount is 700 – 630 = 70x Miscellaneous = [IMG] = 35x Remaining amount = 35x 35x→14000 deposited x=400 Stark initially had 1000x =1000×400= ₹400000

p75mock030.en: The volume of wood required to make a closed box of thickness 2.5 cm with external dimensions 90 cm x 75 cm x 50 cm is: 2.5 सेमी मोटाई और 90 सेमी x 75 सेमी x 50 सेमी बाहरी आयाम वाले एक बंद बॉक्स को बनाने के लिए आवश्यक लकड़ी का आयतन है :
p75mock030.hi: 2.5 सेमी मोटाई और 90 सेमी x 75 सेमी x 50 सेमी बाहरी आयाम वाले एक बंद बॉक्स को बनाने के लिए आवश्यक लकड़ी का आयतन है :
p75mock030.sol: External dimensions: Length = 90cm Breadth = 75cm Height = 50cm Internal dimensions: Length = 90 - 2 ×2.5 = 85 cm Breadth = 75cm - 2 × 2.5 =70cm Height = 50cm - 2 × 2.5 =45cm ⇒ Volume of wood = External volume – Internal volume ⇒ Volume of wood = 90 × 75 × 50 - 85 × 70 × 45 ⇒ Volume of wood = 337500 – 267750 = 69750 cm³

p75mock030.sol: Average Speed for the entire journey = [IMG] =20km/hr [IMG] Time Ratio = 1:1 If time ratio is 1:1, Speed ratio = Distance ratio Hence, required ratio = 3:5

p75mock031.en: A furniture establishment initially disposes of a particular dining table for ₹Z, thereby realising a 25% profit margin. Subsequently, as a promotional strategy for a festive period, the marked price of this identical table is elevated to ₹1.6Z. Following this adjustment, a special concession of 20% is applied to the newly established marked price. The inquiry then seeks to ascertain the resulting percentage profit generated by the store during this specific celebratory sales period. What is the percentage profit earned by the store during the festive sale?
p75mock031.hi: एक फर्नीचर प्रतिष्ठान प्रारंभ में एक विशेष डाइनिंग टेबल को ₹Z में बेचता है , जिससे 25% का लाभ होता है । बाद में , त्योहारी अवधि के प्रचार रणनीति के रूप में , इसी टेबल का अंकित मूल्य ₹1.6Z कर दिया जाता है । इस बदलाव के बाद , इस नए अंकित मूल्य पर 20% की विशेष छूट दी जाती है।प्रश्न यह जानना चाहता है कि इस विशेष त्योहारी बिक्री अवधि में दुकान ने कितने प्रतिशत का लाभ कमाया ।

p75mock031.en: A person observes that the share price of a company has fallen by 12% from the previous day. Expecting a rise, he holds the shares, but the price further falls by 10% the next day. He then sells the shares for ₹1,98,000. How much more money could he have received had he sold the shares the previous day?
p75mock031.hi: एक व्यक्ति ने देखा कि किसी कंपनी के शेयर का मूल्य पिछले दिन की तुलना में 12% गिर गया है । वृद्धि की उम्मीद में उसने शेयर बनाए रखे , लेकिन अगले दिन कीमत और 10% गिर गई । इसके बाद उसने शेयर ₹1,98,000 में बेचे । यदि उसने शेयर पिछले दिन बेचे होते , तो उसे कितना अधिक धन प्राप्त हो सकता था ?
p75mock031.sol: After two falls – 0.88 × 0.9 = 0.792 (effect) SP = ₹ 198000 If he had sold the shares the prev ious day SP = 198000/0.9 = ₹ 220000 Diff erence = money saved = ₹ 22,000

p75mock031.sol: let SP=5 unit Profit =1 unit CP=4 unit Profit% …… = [IMG] ×100=25%

p75mock031.en: The sum of the measures of 7 interior angles of an 8 -sided polygon is 1000°. What is the measure of the 8 th exterior angle of the polygon?
p75mock031.hi: 8 भुजाओं वाले एक बहुभुज के 7 आंतरिक कोणों के मापों का योग 1000° है। इस बहुभुज के 8 वें बाह्य कोण का माप क्या है ?
p75mock031.sol: Each exterior angle =(360°)/n (n ; number of side) = (360°)/8=45° Each interior angle = 180°-45° = 135° (∵ Exterior + interior angle = 180°, in a polygon) Sum of all interior angle = 135°×8=1080° given = Sum of 7 interior angle = 1000° 8th interior angle = (1080°-1000°) = 80° ⇒ So, 8 th exterior angle = 180°-80°=100°

p75mock031.en: Suresh lent out a sum of money to Rakesh for 5 years at simple interest. At the end of 5 years, Rakesh paid 9/8 of the sum to Suresh to clear out the amount. Find the rate of simple interest per annum.

All the three machines start the work at 9:00 a.m. Machine P breaks down at 11:00.a.m and machines Q and R finish the task. The approximate time of completion of the job is:

p75mock032.sol: Efficiency of Machine P : Q : R = Lcm of 8, 10, 15 = 120 P= [IMG] =15 Q= [IMG] =12 R= [IMG] =8 Efficiency of all together = 15 + 12 + 8 = 35 In 2 hours work done = 35 × 2 = 70 Work left =120 [IMG] 70 = 50 Completed by Q & R= [IMG] =2.5 hours Total time taken =11:00 to 2.5 hours =1:30pm

p75mock035.sol: Total work = 15×24×8 = 2880 units Let it taken 'x' days from 7th day to complete the work 15×8×6 + 20×6×x = 2880 720 + 120x = 2880 120x = 2160 x = 2160/120 = 18 days

p75mock036.en: Three concentric circles are designed as part of a target practice board. Their diameters form an arithmetic progression. If the smallest circle has a circumference of 8π cm and the largest circle has the circumference of 20π cm, what is the circumference of the middle circle?
p75mock036.hi: एक टारगेट प्रैक्टिस बोर्ड के हिस्से के तौर पर तीन संकेंद्रित वृत्त बनाए गए हैं। उनके व्यास एक समांतर श्रेणी बनाते हैं। यदि सबसे छोटे वृत्त की परिधि 8π cm है ​​ और सबसे बड़े वृत्त की परिधि 20π cm है , तो बीच वाले वृत्त की परिधि क्या होगी ?
p75mock036.sol: using circumference of circle = 2πr (where r is radius) ATQ, Circumference of smaller circle = 8π Now, let radius of smaller circle = r 2πr=8π r=4 Similarly, according to question 2πr’ =20π (r’ radius of largest) r’=10 let radius of middle circle = R and given they are in AP hence, take r = a , R = a+d , r’= a+2d r’ – r = 10-4=6 a + 2d – a = 6 2d = 6 d = 3 So, R = 4+3 = 7 cm Circumference of middle circle = 2πr=2π×7=14π

From another point B, 40 meters close to the tower along the same straight line, the angle of elevation is 60°. Find the approximate height of the tower and the distance from point A to the base of the tower.
p75mock036.hi: ज़मीन पर एक बिंदु A से , एक टावर के शिखर का उन्नयन कोण 30° है। उसी सीधी रेखा पर टावर से 40 मीटर नज़दीक एक अन्य बिंदु B से , उन्नयन कोण 60° है। टावर की अनुमानित ऊँचाई और बिंदु A से टावर के आधार तक की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।

p75mock036.en: From point H, at 6:30 pm, a train starts moving towards point K at the speed of 90 km/hr. Another train starts moving from point K at 7:30 p.m. towards point H at the speed of 72 km/hr. Both the train meet at 11:30 p.m. at point J. What is the ratio of the distance HJ and KJ?
p75mock036.hi: बिंदु H से , शाम 6:30 बजे , एक रेलगाड़ी 90 किमी / घंटा की गति से बिंदु K की ओर चलना शुरू करती है। दूसरी रेलगाड़ी बिंदु K से शाम 7:30 बजे बिंदु H की ओर 72 किमी / घंटा की गति से चलना शुरू करती है। दोनों रेलगाड़ियाँ रात 11:30 बजे बिंदु J पर मिलती हैं। HJ ​​ और KJ की दूरी का अनुपात क्या है ?
p75mock036.sol: Total time travel by train A is from 6:30 pm to 11:30 pm = 5 hours Distance travel by Train A = 90 × 5 = 450 km Total time travel by train B is from 7:30 pm to 11:30 pm= 4 h Distance travel by Train B = 72 × 4 = 288 km Ratios of Distance travel by train A and train B = 450 : 288 = 25 : 16

p75mock036.en: The cost of tomatoes per kg is increased by 300%. A housewife reduces her consumption of tomatoes by 70%. By what percentage does her expenditure on tomatoes increase or decrease?
p75mock036.hi: प्रति किलोग्राम टमाटर की कीमत में 300% की वृद्धि हुई है। एक गृहिणी टमाटर की खपत में 70% की कमी करती है। टमाटर पर उसका खर्च कितने प्रतिशत बढ़ता या घटता है ?
p75mock036.sol: Price × Consumption = Expenditure P = 10 : 40 C = 100 : 30 10 : 12 [IMG] ×100=20% increase

p75mock036.en: A swimming pool is 40 m in length, 30 m in breadth and 2.2 m depth. The cost of cementing its floor and the four sides at ₹25/m 2 is:
p75mock036.hi: एक स्विमिंग पूल की लंबाई 40 मीटर , चौड़ाई 30 मीटर और गहराई 2.2 मीटर है। इसके फर्श और चारों तरफ सीमेंट लगाने की लागत ₹ 25 /m 2 है :
p75mock036.sol: Required floor = T.S.A of cuboid – Area of roof = 2[lb + bh + hl] – lb = 2[40 × 30 + 30 × 2.2 + 2.2 × 40] - 40×30 = 1508m 2 Required cost = 1508×25 m2 = ₹37,700

p75mock036.en: From a cask filled with wine, 108.75 litres are first drawn and replaced with water. From this mixture, 87 litres are drawn and replaced with water. The ratio of wine to water in the cask is now 3: 2. How many litres of wine did the cask initially hold?
p75mock036.hi: शराब से भरे एक पीपे से , पहले 108.75 लीटर शराब निकाली जाती है और उसे पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। इस मिश्रण से , 87 लीटर शराब निकाली जाती है और उसे पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। पीपे में शराब और पानी का अनुपात अब 3: 2 है। शुरू में पीपे में कितनी लीटर शराब थी ?

p75mock036.en: A sum invested at 8% p.a. amounts to ₹20280 at the end of one year, when the interest is compounded half yearly. What will be the simple interest on the same sum for [IMG] at double the earlier rate of interest?
p75mock036.hi: 8% प्रति वर्ष की दर से निवेश की गई राशि एक वर्ष के अंत में ₹ 20280 हो जाती है , जब ब्याज अर्धवार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है। उसी राशि पर [IMG] के लिए पहले की ब्याज दर से दोगुनी दर पर साधारण ब्याज क्या होगा ?
p75mock036.sol: Half yearly rate = 8/2 = 4% = 1/25 Amount = [IMG] Let the Principal be x [IMG] = [IMG] x = ₹ 18750 SI = [IMG] = ₹13800

p75mock036.en: The difference between the compound interest [compounding half yearly] for 1 year and the simple interest for 1 year on a certain sum lent out at the annual rate of 10 percent is 25. What is the sum?
p75mock036.hi: 10 प्रतिशत की वार्षिक दर से उधार दी गई एक निश्चित राशि पर 1 वर्ष के लिए चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज [ अर्धवार्षिक संयोजन ] और 1 वर्ष के लिए साधारण ब्याज के बीच का अंतर 25 है। राशि क्या है ?
p75mock036.sol: Net Rate for SI of 1 year at the rate 10% = 10% Net Rate for CI = 5+5+[IMG] =10.25% Difference b/w CI and SI = 10.25% [IMG] 10% = 0.25% Sum = [IMG] ×100 = ₹10000

p75mock036.en: A trader sells one brand of tea at ₹160 per kg, incurring a 20% loss. He also sells another brand of tea at ₹240 per kg, incurring a 25% loss. If he mixes the two brands in equal proportions and sells the mixture at ₹190 per kg, what is his overall profit or loss percentage?
p75mock036.hi: एक व्यापारी एक ब्रांड की चाय को ₹160 प्रति किलो में बेचता है और 20% का नुकसान उठाता है । वह दूसरी ब्रांड की चाय को ₹240 प्रति किलो में बेचता है और 25% का नुकसान उठाता है।यदि वह दोनों ब्रांड्स को बराबर अनुपात में मिलाकर मिश्रण बनाता है और उसे ₹190 प्रति किलो में बेचता है , तो उसका कुल लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत क्या होगा ?

p75mock036.en: The selling price of 24 articles is equal to the cost price of 26 articles. What is the gain percentage [correct to one decimal place] in such a situation?
p75mock036.hi: 24 वस्तुओं का विक्रय मूल्य 26 वस्तुओं के क्रय मूल्य के बराबर है। ऐसी स्थिति में लाभ प्रतिशत [ एक दशमलव स्थान तक सही ] क्या है ?

p75mock036.en: What is the equation of the perpendicular bisector of the line segment connecting the points (2, 6) and (8, 4)?
p75mock036.hi: बिंदु ( 2, 6) और ( 8, 4) को जोड़ने वाले रेखा खंड का लंबवत मध्यबिंदु रेखा का समीकरण क्या है ?

p75mock036.en: A trader purchases 80 smartphones at ₹15,000 each. He spends ₹40,000 on transportation and ₹20,000 on advertising. Out of these, 8 smartphones are damaged in transit and sold at a loss of 40%. The remaining smartphones are sold at a profit of 20%. Find the net profit or loss.
p75mock036.hi: एक व्यापारी ने 80 स्मार्टफोन ₹15,000 प्रति स्मार्टफोन की दर से खरीदे । उसने परिवहन पर ₹40,000 और विज्ञापन पर ₹20,000 खर्च किए।इनमें से 8 स्मार्टफोन मार्ग में क्षतिग्रस्त हो गए और उन्हें 40% हानि पर बेचा गया।बाकी के स्मार्टफोन 20% लाभ पर बेचे गए।कुल शुद्ध लाभ या हानि ज्ञात कीजिए ।

p75mock036.en: On selling a table for ₹210 and ₹420 there will be loss of L1% and L2% respectively. If L1-L2 = 7, then what is the cost price of table?
p75mock036.hi: एक टेबल को ₹ 210 और ₹ 420 में बेचने पर क्रमशः L1% और L2% की हानि होगी। यदि L1-L2 = 7 है , तो टेबल का क्रय मूल्य क्या है ?

p75mock036.en: Two circles with radii 6 cm and 2 cm have their centers 10 cm apart. How many common tangents can be drawn between them, and what type(s) of tangents are they?
p75mock036.hi: 6 cm और 2 cm त्रिज्या वाले दो वृत्तों के केंद्र एक - दूसरे से 10 cm की दूरी पर हैं। उनके बीच कितनी उभयनिष्ठ स्पर्श रेखाएँ खींची जा सकती हैं , और वे किस प्रकार की स्पर्श रेखाएँ हैं ?
options: 0 tangents: the larger circle contains the smaller one completely
p75mock036.sol: Given, r₁=6cm and r₂=2cm r₁+r₂= 8cm d=10 cm (given) d > r₁+r₂ thus circles are positioned completely outside of each other [IMG] 4 common: tangents cam be drawn, ie. Two direct common tangents and two transverse common tangents

p75mock036.en: A certain amount is lent at x% p.a. simple interest for 3 years. Instead, if the amount was lent at 3x% p.a. simple interest for 'y’ more years, then the simple interest would have been seven times the earlier interest. What is the value of y?
p75mock036.hi: एक निश्चित राशि को 3 वर्षों के लिए x% प्रतिवर्ष साधारण ब्याज पर उधार दिया जाता है। इसके बजाय , यदि राशि को 'y’ अधिक वर्षों के लिए 3x% प्रतिवर्ष साधारण ब्याज पर उधार दिया जाता , तो साधारण ब्याज पहले के ब्याज से सात गुना होता। y का मान क्या है ?
p75mock036.sol: Let Principal = P, then as per question; 7×p×3×x = p×[3+y]× 3x ⇒ 7=3+y y=4 Hence option B is correct.

p75mock037.en: Due to some crisis, some people from State A migrated to State B, and thereby the population of the second State increased by 19.96%. However, at a later stage, all of them returned to State A. Then by what percentage [correct up to two decimal places] did the population of State B decrease?
p75mock037.hi: किसी संकट के कारण राज्य A के कुछ लोग राज्य B में चले गए , जिससे दूसरे राज्य की जनसंख्या में 19.96% की वृद्धि हुई। हालाँकि , बाद में वे सभी राज्य A में वापस आ गए। तो राज्य B की जनसंख्या में कितने प्रतिशत [ दो दशमलव स्थानों तक सही ] की कमी हुई ?
p75mock037.sol: Let initial population of State B = 10000 As it increases by 19.96% = 11996 Percentage decrease in Population of State B when population returned to State A = [IMG] 100 = 16.64%

p75mock037.en: Raju has ₹11,000 and starts saving ₹5,000 each week towards buying a new laptop. At the same time, Ramesh has ₹60,000 and begins spending ₹2,000 per week-on supplies for his art class. Will there be a week when they have the same amount of money?
p75mock037.hi: राजू के पास ₹ 11,000 हैं और वह हर हफ़्ते ₹ 5,000 बचाकर नया लैपटॉप खरीदने लगता है। वहीं , रमेश के पास ₹ 60,000 हैं और वह अपनी कला कक्षा के लिए हर हफ़्ते ₹ 2,000 खर्च करना शुरू कर देता है। क्या ऐसा कोई हफ़्ता होगा जब उनके पास बराबर पैसे होंगे ?
options: No, they will never have the same amount
p75mock037.sol: Let W is the week When they have same amount 11000+5000w=60,000-2000w 7000w=49000 w=7

p75mock037.en: Three years ago, Raman's salary was Rs. 45000. His salary is increased by 10 percent, A percent and 20 percent in first, second and third year respectively. Raman's present salary is Rs. 83160. What is the value of A?
p75mock037.hi: तीन साल पहले , रमन का वेतन 45000 रुपये था। पहले , दूसरे और तीसरे वर्ष में उसके वेतन में क्रमशः 10 प्रतिशत , A प्रतिशत और 20 प्रतिशत की वृद्धि हुई। रमन का वर्तमान वेतन 83160 रुपये है। A का मान क्या है ?

p75mock037.en: A sells an item at 20% profit to B, B sells the same at 10% profit to C and receives ₹1,32,000. Had C purchased the same item from A, he would have spent 5% less than what he spent with B. What profit would A have made then?
p75mock037.hi: A, B को 20% लाभ पर एक वस्तु बेचता है , B उसी वस्तु को C को 10% लाभ पर बेचता है और ₹ 1,32,000 प्राप्त करता है। यदि C ने वही वस्तु A से खरीदी होती , तो उसने B के साथ किए गए व्यय से 5% कम व्यय किया होता। तब A को कितना लाभ हुआ होता ?
p75mock037.sol: Let CP for A=A A× [IMG] × [IMG] =132000 A =1,00,000 If C purchased from A, S.P. for A =132000× [IMG] =125400 Profit for A =125400-100000=₹25,400

p75mock037.en: How many two-digit numbers satisfy this property? The last digit (unit's digit) of the square of the two-digit number is 9.
p75mock037.hi: कितनी दो - अंकीय संख्याएँ इस गुण को संतुष्ट करती हैं ? उस दो - अंकीय संख्या के वर्ग का अंतिम अंक ( इकाई अंक ) 9 है।
p75mock037.sol: Square has unit digit = 9 ⇒ 2 cases → 3×3 = 9 or 7×7 = 49 Hence, all 2-digit number are 13, 23, ----, 93 → 9 17, 27, 37, ---, 97 → 9 ⇒ Total = 9+9 = 18

p75mock037.en: After two successive increments, a person’s salary became 169% of the original salary. If the percentage increase in the second increment was equal to that in the first increment, then what was the percentage of each increment?

p75mock037.sol: [IMG]

p75mock037.en: Two equal sums are lent at 10% and 8% simple interest p.a. respectively, at the same time. The first sum is received 2 years earlier than the second one and the amount received in each case was ₹36,900. Each sum was_____.

Two litres of A is mixed with 5 litres of B and 3 litres of alcohol is also added to it to get a new solution C. In 1.5 litres of solution C, how much alcohol [in ml] should be mixed so that the ratio of alcohol and water in the final solution becomes 2: 1?

p75mock037.sol: [IMG] = [IMG] = [IMG] = [IMG] Now, water is fix, therefore, after adding alcohol in 1.5ltrs of Solution C ∴ 1.5× [IMG] = [1.5+x]× [IMG] x= [IMG] L =375ml We should mix 375 ml alcohol to get final ratio of alcohol and water 2:1.

p75mock037.en: A triangle PQR, angle P=50°, Q=60°, and side PQ=10cm. Find the angle between sides PR and QR?
p75mock037.hi: एक त्रिभुज PQR है , जिसमें कोण P = 50°, Q = 60° और भुजा PQ = 10 cm है। भुजाओं PR और QR के बीच का कोण ज्ञात कीजिए।
p75mock037.sol: [IMG] given: ∠ P=50° ∠ Q=60° ∠ P+ ∠ LR=180° (sum of angles of triangle is 180°) ∠ R= 180°-(50°+60°) ∠ R=70° this is the angle that lies between PR and QR.

p75mock037.en: If the 9-digit number 72x8431y4 is divisible by 36, what is the value of [IMG] for the smallest possible value of y, given that x and y are natural numbers?

p75mock037.sol: 72x8431y4 must be divisible by 9 and 4 y4 divisible by 4 For the smallest value of y. y=2 7+2+x+8+4+3+1+2+4= 31+x x=5 [IMG] = [IMG] - [IMG] = [IMG] = [IMG]

p75mock037.en: What is the least five-digit number which when decreased by 7 is divisible by 15, 24, 28 and 32?
p75mock037.hi: पाँच अंकों की वह सबसे छोटी संख्या क्या है जो 7 घटाने पर 15, 24, 28 और 32 से विभाज्य हो जाती है ?
p75mock037.sol: LCM of 15, 24, 28 and 32= 3360 Smallest five-digit number multiple of 3360 = 3360×3=10080 Required number = 10080+7 =10087

He offers further discount of 20% if the buyer presents his membership card of the retailer’s store. The profit of the retailer with the membership card scheme is what percentage of the profit of the retailer without the membership card scheme?
p75mock038.hi: एक खुदरा विक्रेता 92,000 रुपये में एयर - कंडीशनर बाजार में बेचने के लिए 30% की छूट की घोषणा करता है। एयर - कंडीशनर का क्रय मूल्य अंकित मूल्य से 70% कम है। यदि खरीदार खुदरा विक्रेता के स्टोर का सदस्यता कार्ड प्रस्तुत करता है , तो वह 20% की अतिरिक्त छूट प्रदान करता है। सदस्यता कार्ड योजना के साथ खुदरा विक्रेता का लाभ सदस्यता कार्ड योजना के बिना खुदरा विक्रेता के लाभ का कितना प्रतिशत है ?
p75mock038.sol: Let MP=100,CP=30 then, without members hip, SP=70 so, Profit =70-30=40 and with membership, SP=100×70%×80%=56 So, Profit =56-30=26 ∴ Required %= [IMG] ×100=65%
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 147 . [IMG]

p75mock038.sol: Since, A→ [IMG] →18 days, A can complete the whole work in 30 days B→ 2/5→10 days, B can complete the whole work in 25 days [IMG] They work together for 10 days only 11×10=110 Remaining work =150 [IMG] 110 = 40 Completed by C in 4 days = [IMG] =10 So, efficiency of C =10 C can complete the whole work= [IMG] =15 days
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 25. (5 + 7) + (9 + 4) = 12 + 13 = 25

p75mock038.sol: P→ [IMG] →18 = 72 days Now 37.5% work has done 62.5% left and will be completed by Q in 40 days Q can complete all work in = [IMG] ×100 = 64 days Let Total work =LCM of 64 & 72 = 576 Efficiency of P = [IMG] =8 and efficiency of Q = [IMG] = 9 Therefore the required time = [IMG] = 12 days

p75mock038.en: Jehangir had to cover a distance of 90 km in an hour. During the first 25 minutes travelled at a speed of 15.2 metres per second. How many metres did Jehangir cover per second during the remaining period to reach his destination on time?
p75mock038.hi: जहाँगीर को एक घंटे में 90 किलोमीटर की दूरी तय करनी थी। पहले 25 मिनट के दौरान उसने 15.2 मीटर प्रति सेकंड की गति से यात्रा की। समय पर अपने गंतव्य तक पहुँचने के लिए जहाँगीर ने शेष अवधि के दौरान प्रति सेकंड कितने मीटर की दूरी तय की ?
p75mock038.sol: Distance = 90km = 90000 m Time =1h = 3600sec Formula Distance = speed × Time Time spent = 25min = 25 × 60 = 1500sec Distance covered in 25min = 15.2 × 1500 = 22800m Remaining Distance = 90000 - 22800 = 67200m Remaining Time =3600 - 1500 = 2100sec = 67200m/2100s = 32m/s

Take [IMG] = 3.14

p75mock039.en: A typist uses a paper of size 32 cm x 20 cm. He leaves a margin of 2cm each on all the sides. If he leaves a margin of 1 cm only on all the sides then what is the percentage of the increase in the area available for typing [correct to 2 decimal places]?

p75mock039.sol: If he leaves 2cm each Length = 32 – 2 – 2 = 28 Breadth = 20 – 2 – 2 = 16 Area =28×16=448 If he leaves margin of 1cm each Length = 32 – 1 – 1 = 30 Breadth = 20 – 1 – 1 = 18 Area =30×18=540 % change = [IMG] ×100=20.54%

p75mock041.en: Train A running at 81 km/h takes 72 sec to overtake train B, when both the trains are running in the same direction, but it takes 36 sec to cross each other if the trains are running in the opposite direction. If the length of train B is 600 metres, then find the length of train A. [in metres]
p75mock041.hi: 81 किमी / घंटा की गति से चलने वाली ट्रेन A को ट्रेन B से आगे निकलने में 72 सेकंड लगते हैं , जब दोनों ट्रेनें एक ही दिशा में चल रही हों , लेकिन अगर ट्रेनें विपरीत दिशा में चल रही हों तो उन्हें एक - दूसरे को पार करने में 36 सेकंड लगते हैं। यदि ट्रेन B की लंबाई 600 मीटर है , तो ट्रेन A की लंबाई ज्ञात करें। [ मीटर में ]
p75mock041.sol: Let the length of train A is A Let the speed of train B is x D istance = relative speed × time When both the trains are running in the same direction, ⇒ A + 600 = [81 – x] × [IMG] × 72 ⇒ A + 600 = [81 – x] × 20 ⇒ A + 20 x = 1620 - 600 ⇒ A + 20 x = 1020 --------- {1} When both trains are running in the opposite direction: Distance = relative speed × time ⇒ A + 600 = [81 + x] × [IMG] × 36 ⇒ A + 600 = [81 + x] × 10 ⇒ A - 10 x = 810 - 600 ⇒ A - 10 x = 210 Multiply both sides by 2 ⇒ 2 A - 20 x = 420 ⇒ 20 x = 2 A - 420 --------- {2} Now, put the value of eq. {2} in eq. {1} ⇒ A + 20 x = 1020 ⇒ A + 2A - 420 = 1020 ⇒ 3 A = 1440 ⇒ A = 480

p75mock044.sol: Let No. of boys & girls be 100B & 100G respectively Failed student 20B + 15G = 90 ----1 Passed boys = 80B Passed Girls = 85G ⇒ 80B=70+85G-----2 By solving eq 1 & 2 G = 2 B = 3 So, total No. of students = 100B + 100G = 200 + 300 = 500

p75mock046.sol: [IMG] ⇒ Work = efficiency × Time ⇒work = [3 + 2 + 1] × 3 D alone can empty this amount in 30 hours ⇒ Efficiency of D = [IMG] = [IMG] D alone can empty full tank = x = [IMG] = 50 hours

p75mock046.en: Find the sum of squares of the greatest value and the smallest value of K in the number so that the number 45082K is divisible by 3.
p75mock046.hi: संख्या में K के सबसे बड़े मान और सबसे छोटे मान के वर्गों का योग ज्ञात कीजिए ताकि संख्या 45082K, 3 से विभाज्य हो।
p75mock046.sol: Divisibility of 3: The sum of all digits of the number must be divisible by 3. 4+5+0+8+2+K = 19+k Smallest value of k = 2, and largest value of k = 8 Required sum = [IMG] + [IMG] = 68
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 22.64 . \(\sqrt{484+28}\) a = 484, b = 28 Square root = \(\sqrt a + \frac{b}{2\sqrt a}\) = \(\sqrt {484} + \frac{28}{2\sqrt {484}}\) = 22 + 14/22 = 22.64

p75mock046.en: A light beam reflects such that tanA + cotA = 8 and A is an acute angle. Find the value of tan³ A + cot³ A
p75mock046.hi: प्रकाश की एक किरण इस प्रकार परावर्तित होती है कि tanA + cotA = 8 , और A एक न्यून कोण है। tan ³ A + cot ³ A का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
p75mock046.sol: tanA + CotA = 8 Squaring both side tan² A + Cot² A + 2tanA CotA = 64 tan² A + Cot² A = 62 tan³ A + Cot³ A = (tanA + CotA)(tan² A + Cot² A - tanA CotA) [∵using identity a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² + b² - ab)] (8)(62 - 1) = 8 × 61 = 488

p75mock046.en: Akshara and Siddharth travel from point P to Q, a distance of 72 km at a rate of 8 km/h and 10 km/h, respectively. Siddharth reaches Q first and returns immediately and meets Akshara at R. Find the distance from P to R.
p75mock046.hi: अक्षरा और सिद्धार्थ क्रमशः 8 किमी / घंटा और 10 किमी / घंटा की गति से बिंदु P से Q तक 72 किमी की दूरी तय करते हैं। सिद्धार्थ पहले Q पर पहुँचता है और तुरंत वापस लौटता है और R पर अक्षरा से मिलता है। P से R तक की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
p75mock046.sol: let the distance between R to Q = x km Distance travelled by Siddharth =72 + x Distance travelled by Akshara =72 - x In the same time Siddharth travelled [72 + x] km distance with speed of 10 km/hr and Akshara travelled [72 - x] km distance with speed of 8 km/hr [IMG] = [IMG] 576 + 8x = 720 - 10x 18x = 144 x = 8 The distance from P to R = 72 [IMG] 8 = 64 km

p75mock047.en: In an examination a candidate had to sit for three papers A, B and C. The candidate secured 75% marks in Paper A, 80% marks in Paper B, and 60% marks in Paper C. If the weightage assigned to Papers A, B and C were 40%, 50% and 10%, respectively, then find the weighted percentage of marks obtained by the candidate, when all the three papers were taken together.
p75mock047.hi: एक परीक्षा में एक अभ्यर्थी को तीन पेपर A, B और C देने थे। अभ्यर्थी ने पेपर A में 75% अंक , पेपर B में 80% अंक और पेपर C में 60% अंक प्राप्त किए। यदि पेपर A, B और C को दिया गया भार क्रमशः 40%, 50% और 10% था , तो अभ्यर्थी द्वारा प्राप्त अंकों का भार प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए , जब सभी तीन पेपर एक साथ लिए गए थे।

p75mock047.en: Find the total amount of debt that will be discharged by 5 equal instalments of ₹200 each, if the debt is due in 5 years at 5% p.a. at simple interests.
p75mock047.hi: ऋण की कुल राशि ज्ञात कीजिए जिसे ₹ 200 प्रत्येक की 5 बराबर किस्तों में चुकाया जाएगा , यदि ऋण 5% प्रति वर्ष की दर से साधारण ब्याज पर 5 वर्षों में चुकाना है।
p75mock047.sol: Let Instalment =100Rs Using Instalment concept, total amount of debt is 100+105+110+115+120=550 Now; as per question; 100 unit ⟶200 Rs ∴ 550 unit → 550×2=1100Rs

p75mock047.en: Archana took a loan of ₹78,000 from a bank on 24th January 2012 at [IMG] % per annum for simple interest and paid it back on 18th June 2012. Find the total amount paid by Archana. [Approximated to nearest integer].
p75mock047.hi: अर्चना ने 24 जनवरी 2012 को एक बैंक से [IMG] % प्रति वर्ष की दर से साधारण ब्याज पर ₹ 78,000 का ऋण लिया और 18 जून 2012 को इसे वापस चुका दिया। अर्चना द्वारा भुगतान की गई कुल राशि ज्ञात कीजिए। [ निकटतम पूर्णांक तक अनुमानित ] ।
p75mock047.sol: Total days from 24 th Jan 2012 to 18 th June 2012 =8+29+31+30+31+17=146days ∴ SI= [IMG] =2722.54 Amount=78000+2722.54=80722.54∼80723 Hence, option A is correct.

p75mock047.en: A ring-shaped disc has outer radius 20 cm and inner radius 10 cm. What is the approximate ratio of the ring’s area to the whole outer circle?
p75mock047.hi: एक वलयाकार डिस्क की बाहरी त्रिज्या 20 cm और भीतरी त्रिज्या 10 cm है। वलय के क्षेत्रफल और पूरे बाहरी वृत्त के क्षेत्रफल का अनुमानित अनुपात क्या है ?
p75mock047.sol: Area of ring = π(outer radius²-inner radius²) Area of ring=π(20²-10²)=π(400-100)=300π Area of outer circle = π×(20)²=400π Required ratio= 300π∶400π=3:4

p75mock047.en: A hot-air ballon directly above point A is rising vertically at 5 m/s. An observer at point B, 400 m due east of A, watches the ballon. At the moment when the angle of elevation is 30°, how long until it reaches an angle of elevation of 60°? (Assume no horizontal drift.)
p75mock047.hi: पॉइंट A के ठीक ऊपर एक हॉट - एयर बैलून 5 m/s की रफ़्तार से सीधा ऊपर उठ रहा है। A से 400 m पूर्व में पॉइंट B पर एक ऑब्ज़र्वर बैलून को देख रहा है। जिस समय एलिवेशन एंगल 30° है , उसे 60° के एलिवेशन एंगल तक पहुँचने में कितना समय लगेगा ? ( मान लें कि कोई हॉरिजॉन्टल ड्रिफ्ट नहीं है। )

p75mock047.en: Places A and B are 45 km apart from each other. A car starts from place A and another car starts from place B at the same time. If they move in the same direction, they meet in 4 and a half hour and if they move towards each other, they meet in 27 minutes. What is the speed [in km/h] of the car which moves faster?
p75mock047.hi: स्थान A और B एक दूसरे से 45 किमी दूर हैं। एक कार स्थान A से शुरू होती है और दूसरी कार स्थान B से एक ही समय पर शुरू होती है। यदि वे एक ही दिशा में चलते हैं , तो वे साढ़े 4 घंटे में मिलते हैं और यदि वे एक दूसरे की ओर बढ़ते हैं , तो वे 27 मिनट में मिलते हैं। तेज़ चलने वाली कार की गति [ किमी / घंटा में ] क्या है ?
p75mock047.sol: Let speed of faster car = x km/h Speed of slower car = y km/h Relative speed when car moves in same direction = [x [IMG] y] km/h Relative speed when car moves in opposite direction = [x + y] km/h In same direction [IMG] = 4.5 [x – y] = 10 --------{1} Now, in opposite direction [IMG] = [IMG] [x + y] = 100 -------{2} Adding equation 1 & equation 2 2x = 110 x = 55

p75mock047.en: A number is first increased by 16% and then increased by 14%. The number, so obtained, is now decreased by 30%. What is the net increase or decrease percent in the original number [number to an integer]?
p75mock047.hi: एक संख्या को पहले 16% बढ़ाया जाता है और फिर 14% बढ़ाया जाता है। इस प्रकार प्राप्त संख्या में अब 30% की कमी की जाती है। मूल संख्या [ पूर्णांक में संख्या ] में शुद्ध वृद्धि या कमी प्रतिशत क्या है ?
p75mock047.sol: Let the no be 100 100 : 100 [IMG] 100000∶92568 7% decrease approx. Alternate Method : 16 + 14 + [IMG] = 32.24 32.24-30- [IMG] =-7.432%=7% approx

p75mock047.en: A rectangular sheet of metal is 60 cm × 25 cm. Equal squares of side 5 cm are cut off at the corners and the remainder is folded up to form an open rectangular box. Find the volume of the box.
p75mock047.hi: धातु की एक आयताकार शीट 60 सेमी × 25 सेमी है। 5 सेमी भुजा वाले बराबर वर्गों को कोनों पर काटा जाता है और शेष को मोड़कर एक खुला आयताकार बॉक्स बनाया जाता है। बॉक्स का आयतन ज्ञात कीजिए ।
p75mock047.sol: After cutting 5cm squares from each side’s corner. New Length = 60 - 10 = 50cm New Breadth = 25 - 10 = 15cm New Height = 5cm Volume of the box= l × b × h = 50 × 15 × 5 = 3750 cm³

p75mock047.en: On a sum of money, when in-vested for 2 years, compound interest and simple interest are ₹300 and ₹250, respectively. For both simple and com-pound interests the rate of interest per annum is the same, and for compound interest, interest is compounded annually. Find the rate of interest per annum.
p75mock047.hi: किसी धनराशि पर , जब 2 वर्षों के लिए निवेश किया जाता है , तो चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज और साधारण ब्याज क्रमशः ₹ 300 और ₹ 250 होते हैं। साधारण और चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज दोनों के लिए प्रति वर्ष ब्याज की दर समान होती है , और चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज के लिए , ब्याज वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है। प्रति वर्ष ब्याज की दर ज्ञात करें।
p75mock047.sol: Simple interest for 1 year = 250/2 = 125 And CI on second year is 350 - 250 = 50 Hence, 125 × r% = 50 r% = 40%

p75mock047.en: A mobile phone retailer sells a phone for ₹P and earns a profit of 15%. For a special festive offer, he marks the same phone at ₹1.4P. At the offer, he provides a discount of 12%. What will be the percentage profit that he will make during the festive offer (approx.)?

p75mock047.en: A dealer buys an article listed at ₹300 and gets successive discounts of 10% and 20%. He spends 12% of the cost price on transportation. At what price should he sell the article to earn a profit of 30%?

p75mock047.sol: MP = 300, Disc =10%, 20% SP of seller = 300 × 9/10 × 8/10 = 216 CP of dealer = SP of seller = 216 →SP of dealer = 216 × 112/100 × 13/10 = ₹ 314.50

p75mock048.en: Three candidates X, Y and Z participated in an election. X got 30% more votes than Y, whereas Z got 25% more votes than Y. X also overtook Z by 5000 votes. If 71% of the voters voted and no invalid votes were cast, then what was the total number of voters in the voting list?
p75mock048.hi: तीन उम्मीदवार X, Y और Z ने एक चुनाव में भाग लिया। X को Y से 30% अधिक वोट मिले , जबकि Z को Y से 25% अधिक वोट मिले। X ने Z को 5000 वोटों से पीछे छोड़ दिया। यदि 71% मतदाताओं ने मतदान किया और कोई भी अवैध वोट नहीं डाला गया , तो मतदान सूची में कुल मतदाताओं की संख्या क्या थी ?

p75mock052.en: Amit can finish the work in 15 days, and Baban can finish the same work in 25 days. They work together for 5 days. The rest of the work was finished by Amit and Chetan in 4 days. How much time is required for Chetan to finish this work?
p75mock052.hi: अमित किसी काम को 15 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है , और बबन उसी काम को 25 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। वे दोनों मिलकर 5 दिनों तक काम करते हैं। बचा हुआ काम अमित और चेतन ने मिलकर 4 दिनों में पूरा किया। चेतन को यह काम पूरा करने में कितना समय लगेगा ?
p75mock052.sol: [IMG] Efficiency of Amit and Baban 5,3 respectively In 8 days work done = 8×5 = 40 units Remaining work = (75-40) = 35 units Amit + Chetan do remaining work in 4 days = 35/4 = 8 3/4 efficiency of Chetan = 3 (3/4) = 15/4 Time taken by Chetan to complete the work = 75/(15/4) = 20 days

p75mock052.en: In a circle, ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral in which AE is drawn parallel to CD, and BA is produced to F. If ∠ ABC = 85 ° and ∠ FAE = 24 ° , find the value of ∠BCD.
p75mock052.hi: एक वृत्त में , ABCD एक चक्रीय चतुर्भुज है जिसमें AE को CD के समान्तर खींचा गया है , और BA को F तक बढ़ाया गया है। यदि ∠ ABC = 85° और ∠ FAE = 24° है , तो ∠ BCD का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
p75mock052.sol: [IMG] Since ∠CDA + ∠CBA=180 ° [Cyclic quadrilateral] = ∠CDA = 180 ° - 85 ° = 95 ° ∠ CDA = ∠DAE = 95[Alternate ∠ Theorem] Now, ∠FAD = 24 ° + 95 ° = 119 ° ∠ BCD = ∠FAD =119 ° [Alternate exterior angle of cyclic quadrilateral]

p75mock052.en: Three pipes A, B, C can fill an empty cistern in 2, 3, and 6 hours respectively. They are opened together. After what time C should be closed, so that the cistern gets filled in exactly 1 hr 15 min?

p75mock052.en: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral, The tangents to the circle at the points A and C on it, intersect at P. If [IMG] ABC = 58°, then what is the measure of [IMG] APC?

p75mock052.en: A field roller, in the shape of a cylinder, has a diameter of 1 m and length of [IMG] m. If the speed at which the roller rolls is 14 revolutions per minute, then the maximum area [in [IMG] ] that it can roll in 1 hour is [take [IMG] ]

p75mock052.en: The length of the base of a triangle is 3 cm smaller than the length of its altitude. Its area is 104 cm². What is the length of the base?
p75mock052.hi: एक त्रिभुज के आधार की लंबाई उसके शीर्षलम्ब की लंबाई से 3 सेमी कम है। इसका क्षेत्रफल 104 cm² है। आधार की लंबाई क्या है ?
p75mock052.sol: let length of altitude = a then length of base = a – 3 Now: Area = [IMG] × base × Height ⇒ 104 = [IMG] × [a – 3][a] = 208 = a 2 - 3a = a 2 - 3a – 208 = 0 ⇒ [a – 16][a + 13]=0 a =16 or a = - 13. So a =16, then base =16 - 3 =13cm.

p75mock052.en: A decorative column is made in the shape of a regular hexagonal prism. The side length of its base is 12 cm. The column is built from multiple sections, and their heights form an arithmetic progression: the first section is 6 cm tall, and each subsequent section is 3 cm taller than the previous one. If the column has 4 sections in total, what is the total volume of the column?
p75mock052.hi: एक सजावटी खंभा एक नियमित षट्भुजाकार प्रिज्म के आकार का बनाया गया है। इसके आधार की भुजा की लंबाई 12 cm है। यह खंभा कई हिस्सों से मिलकर बना है , और उनकी ऊँचाइयाँ एक समांतर श्रेणी (AP) बनाती हैं : पहला हिस्सा 6 cm ऊँचा है , और उसके बाद का हर हिस्सा पिछले हिस्से से 3 cm ज़्यादा ऊँचा है। यदि इस खंभे में कुल 4 हिस्से हैं , तो इस खंभे का कुल आयतन कितना होगा ?
p75mock052.sol: A regular hexagon with side '9' has area A=(3√3)/2 a² given, a=12cm A=(3√3)/2×12×12 A=216√3 cm² Heights of sections are in AP First term =6cm, Common difference =3cm Number of sections: 4 Heights: 6,9,12,15 =6+9+12+15=42cm Volume of prism = Base Area × Total height =216√3×42 =9072√3 cm³

p75mock053.en: Point P is at an equal distance from the three vertices of a triangle with coordinates X (0, 0), Y (6, 0), and Z (0, 4). What are the coordinates of point P?

p75mock053.sol: [IMG] P → Circumcentre (Intersection of perpendicular bisectors) A = midpoint. of XY = (0+6)/2,(0+0)/2 = (3, 0) Slope of XY = (0-0)/(0-6) = 0 Equation of ⊥ bisector of XY: x = 3 C = midpoint. of XZ = (0+0)/2,(0+4)/2 = (0, 2) Slope of XZ = (4-0)/(0-0) = ∞ Equation of ⊥ bisector of XZ: y = 2 P = intersection of both lines P = (3, 2)
