p75mock056.sol: Sum of Present age of family = [38+10] ×5 = 48 × 5 =240 & sum of Present age of family of 7 members [Including 2 New members] = 38×7=266 ∴ Sum of age of 2 New members =266 [IMG] 240 = 26 Given difference = 8 yrs ∴ The younger one = [IMG] = [IMG] = 9yrs

p75mock056.en: The average of 15 numbers is 84. The average of the first 6 numbers is 70. The average of the next 6 numbers is 20% more than the average of the first 6 numbers. The 13th number is 8 more than the 15th number, and the 14th number is 2 less than the 15th number. What is the average of the 13th and 14th numbers?
p75mock056.hi: 15 संख्याओं का औसत 84 है। पहली 6 संख्याओं का औसत 70 है। अगली 6 संख्याओं का औसत , पहली 6 संख्याओं के औसत से 20% अधिक है। 13 वीं संख्या , 15 वीं संख्या से 8 अधिक है , और 14 वीं संख्या , 15 वीं संख्या से 2 कम है। 13 वीं और 14 वीं संख्याओं का औसत क्या है ?
p75mock056.sol: Total Sum = 15 × 84 = 1260 Sum of first 6 numbers = 6 × 70 = 420 Sum of next six numbers = 70 × 6/5 × 6 = 504 Sum of last three = 1260 - (420 + 504) = 1260 - 924 = 336 Let 15th num be x. 13th = x + 8 14th = x - 2 x + (x + 8) + (x - 2) = 336 3x + 6 = 336 3x = 330 x = 110 Avg of 13th & 14th = (x + 8 + x - 2)/2 = (2x + 6)/2 ⇒ x + 3 = 113

p75mock057.sol: Given, CI= 820 and Amount = ₹ 8820 Principal = Amount – CI=8820-820 = ₹ 8000 Net R% = [IMG] ×100 =10.25% The rate of interest is 5%

p75mock057.en: 20 students of a college went to a hotel. 19 of them spent ₹175 each on their meal and the 20th student spent ₹19 more than the average of all the 20. Find the total money spent by them.
p75mock057.hi: एक कॉलेज के 20 छात्र एक होटल में गए। उनमें से 19 ने अपने भोजन पर प्रत्येक ₹ 175 खर्च किए और 20 वें छात्र ने सभी 20 के औसत से ₹ 19 अधिक खर्च किए। उनके द्वारा खर्च की गई कुल धनराशि ज्ञात कीजिए।
p75mock057.sol: Total students = 20 Let avg spends by each students = x ∴ Total spend =20x Now, 20x=19×175+[x+19] 19x = 3344 , ⇒ x=176 ∴ Total Expense =20×176 = 3520 2 nd method: given that 20 th student spent 19 Rs. more than the avg of all 20 students, then it is clear that these 19 Rs. should be spent by other 19 students Therefore each of them would spent [IMG] =1Rs more ∴ Share of each person =175+1=176 Total expense =20×176 = 3520Rs

p75mock057.en: Sudarshan can copy 50 pages in 10 hours; Sudarshan and Prakash together can copy 300 pages in 40 hours. In how much time can Prakash copy 25 pages?

p75mock057.sol: Sudarshan's efficiency = 50 page / 10 hour = 5 page/hour Sudarshan + Prabhash = 300 page / 40 hour = 7.5 page / hour Prabhash's efficiency = (7.5-5) = 2.5 page / hour [IMG]

p75mock057.en: S and T are points on the sides PQ and PR, respectively, of [IMG] PQR such that PS × PR = PQ [IMG] PT. If [IMG] Q = 96° and [IMG] PST = [IMG] PRQ + 34°, then [IMG] QPR = ?

p75mock057.en: A delivery boy started from his office at 10 a.m. to deliver an article. He rode his scooter at a speed of 32 km/h. He delivered the article and waited for 15 minutes to get the payment. After the payment was made, he reached his office at 11.25 a.m., travelling at a speed of 24 km/h. Find the total distance travelled by the boy.

p75mock057.sol: 10 am to 11:25am, = 1 hour 25 min- 15 min.[waiting time] Total time = 1 hr 10 min Speed ⟶ 32 : 24=4 : 3 Time ⟶ 3 : 4 7x ⟶ 70 min x=10 min Total distance = speed × time 32 × [IMG] +24 × [IMG] = 16 + 16= 32 km

p75mock057.en: Two right prisms have the same height of 15 cm. One has a regular hexagonal base with side 10 cm, and the other has a square base with side 10 cm. What is the ratio of their volumes?
p75mock057.hi: दो लंब प्रिज्मों की ऊँचाई समान , यानी 15 cm है। एक का आधार 10 cm भुजा वाला एक सम - षट्भुज है , और दूसरे का आधार 10 cm भुजा वाला एक वर्ग है। उनके आयतनों का अनुपात क्या है ?
p75mock057.sol: Volume of prism = Base Area × height ∴ given, height is same for both when we take the ratio of volume → height will cancel out. Area of regular hexagon with side ' a '=(3√3)/2 a² =(3√3)/2×100=150√3 Area of square=(side)² =10²=100 Required Ratio =150√3:100 of volume =3√3:2

p75mock057.en: I n an examination, 80% of students passed in English, 70% of students passed in Hindi and 15% failed in both the subjects. What is the percentage of students who failed in only one subject?

p75mock057.sol: 80% pass in English 20% fail in English 70% pass in Hindi 30% fail in Hindi 15% fail in Both Students failed only in English =20-15=5% Students failed only in Hindi =30-15=15% Total 5+15=20%

p75mock058.en: A circular clock has a radius of 21cm. Calculate the distance covered by the tip of the minute hand in 20 minutes, assuming it is positioned at the edge of the clock face? (Use= π=22/7)

p75mock058.sol: Circumference of clock = 2 × (22/7) × 21 = 132 cm Distance covered by minute hand in 60 minutes = 132 cm Distance covered in 20 minutes =132/3 cm = 44 cm

p75mock058.sol: A-1=B+1 A – B = 2 -----i A + 1 = 2[B – 1] A + 1 = 2B – 2 A – 2B = -3 ---- ii i – ii B=5 A=7 Total number of toffees with A and B = 12

p75mock059.sol: LCM of 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 = 420 Number divisible by 420 and lies between 2800 and 3000 = 420×7 =2940 Remainder should be 1, so the number = 2940 + 1 = 2941 The sum of the digits of 2941 = 16

p75mock059.hi: 24 कर्मचारियों और उनके पर्यवेक्षक की औसत आयु 41 वर्ष है। यदि पर्यवेक्षक की आयु को निकाल दिया जाए , तो औसत 0.75 वर्ष कम हो जाता है। पर्यवेक्षक की आयु है :
p75mock059.sol: By removing supervisor diff. in avg = - 0.75 Now total people =24 Total reduction =24 × 0.75 =18 yrs Age of supervisor = 41 + 18 = 59 yrs.

p75mock059.en: A can complete a certain work in 30 days. B is 20% more efficient than A. C can complete [IMG] part of the same work in 8 days. A and B together complete [IMG] part of the work. The remaining work remaining work is completed by A and C together. In how many days was the entire work completed?
p75mock059.hi: A किसी काम को 30 दिन में पूरा कर सकता है। B, A से 20% अधिक दक्ष है। C उसी काम का [IMG] भाग 8 दिन में पूरा कर सकता है। A और B मिलकर काम का [IMG] भाग पूरा करते हैं। शेष काम A और C मिलकर पूरा करते हैं। पूरा काम कितने दिन में पूरा हुआ ?
p75mock059.sol: Efficiency = A : B = 5 : 6 Time = A : B = 6 : 5 A = 30 days then B = [IMG] × 5 = 25 days Total work = 30 × 5 =150 Efficiency of C = [IMG] × [IMG] =7.5 A+B have completed 11/15 of work, so work left =150 × [IMG] = 40 Time taken by A + B together = [IMG] =10 days Time taken by A + C together = [IMG] = [IMG] days Therefore, the entire work complete in = 10 days + [IMG] days = [IMG] days

p75mock059.en: An isosceles [IMG] MNP is inscribed in a circle. If MN = MP =16 [IMG] cm, and NP = 32 cm, what is the radius [in cm] of the circle?
p75mock059.hi: एक समद्विबाहु [IMG] MNP एक वृत्त में अंकित है। यदि MN = MP = 16 [IMG] सेमी , और NP = 32 सेमी , तो वृत्त की त्रिज्या [ सेमी में ] क्या है ?
p75mock059.sol: [IMG] Given that, △MNP is isosceles MN = MP = 16√5 NP = 32cm Let MD ⊥ NP & , ND = DP =16cm, ∴ In △MND DM = [IMG] [Pythagoras] DM = \(\sqrt{(16\sqrt{5})^2 - 16^2}\) = 16 × 2 = 32cm Now; circumradius of △ NPM= [IMG] ∴ k = [IMG] R = 20cm

p75mock059.en: Two motorists start together to travel to a certain destination, one at the speed of 4 km/h and the other at the speed of 6 km/h. Find the distance travelled by them [in km] if the motorist travelling at 4 km/h arrives half an hour after the other motorist.
p75mock059.hi: दो मोटर चालक एक निश्चित गंतव्य की यात्रा के लिए एक साथ यात्रा शुरू करते हैं , एक 4 किमी / घंटा की गति से और दूसरा 6 किमी / घंटा की गति से। यदि 4 किमी / घंटा की गति से यात्रा करने वाला मोटर चालक दूसरे मोटर चालक से आधे घंटे बाद पहुंचता है , तो उनके द्वारा तय की गई दूरी [ किमी में ] ज्ञात कीजिए।
p75mock059.sol: Formula Distance = Speed × Time Speed of first motorist = 4km/h Speed of second motorist = 6km/h Let Time of second motorist =T Then Time of first motorist = [IMG] Their distance must be the same Distance 1 = Distance 2 4 × [IMG] = 6 × T 4T + 2 = 6T 2T = 2 T =1 hour Distance = 6km/h × 1 hour = 6km

p75mock060.en: Three years ago, the difference between the age of Ravish and the age of Kailash was 18 years. Three years from today, Ravish will be three times as old as Kailash. What is the present age of Ravish [in years]?
p75mock060.hi: तीन साल पहले , रवीश और कैलाश की उम्र के बीच 18 साल का अंतर था। आज से तीन साल बाद , रवीश की उम्र कैलाश से तीन गुना होगी। रवीश की वर्तमान उम्र [ सालों में ] क्या है ?

p75mock060.en: To do a certain task X would take 3 times as long as Y and Z together; and Z would take 4 times as long as Y and X together. Three of them together can complete the task in 10 days. How much time is taken by X and Z to complete the task? किसी कार्य को करने में X को Y और Z को मिलाकर जितना समय लगेगा , उससे 3 गुना समय लगेगा ; और Z को Y और X को मिलाकर जितना समय लगेगा , उससे 4 गुना समय लगेगा। तीनों मिलकर उस कार्य को 10 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। X और Z को कार्य पूरा करने में कितना समय लगेगा ?
p75mock060.hi: किसी कार्य को करने में X को Y और Z को मिलाकर जितना समय लगेगा , उससे 3 गुना समय लगेगा ; और Z को Y और X को मिलाकर जितना समय लगेगा , उससे 4 गुना समय लगेगा। तीनों मिलकर उस कार्य को 10 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। X और Z को कार्य पूरा करने में कितना समय लगेगा ?
p75mock060.sol: Time → X : Y + Z = 3 : 1; Z : Y + X = 4 : 1 Efficiency = X : Y + Z = 1 : 3; Z :Y + X = 1 : 4 To make sum of efficiency equal = X : Y + Z = 5 : 15; Z : Y + X = 4 : 16 Therefore, X = 5; Z = 4; Y = 11 Total work = 20 × 10 = 200 Time taken by X and Z together= [IMG] = [IMG] days

p75mock060.en: Raju buys 75 articles at the same price each. He sells one-third of them at a profit of 40% and 20% of the remaining at a profit of 20%. He sells the remaining articles at a loss equal to the cost price of 7 articles. What is his gain/loss percent in his entire transaction?
p75mock060.hi: राजू एक ही कीमत पर 75 वस्तुएं खरीदता है। वह उनमें से एक तिहाई को 40% के लाभ पर और शेष 20% को 20% के लाभ पर बेचता है। वह शेष वस्तुओं को 7 वस्तुओं के लागत मूल्य के बराबर हानि पर बेचता है। उसके पूरे लेन - देन में उसका लाभ / हानि प्रतिशत क्या है ?
p75mock060.sol: Total CP OF 75 articles=75 The selling price of 25 articles = 25 + 40% of 25 ⇒ 25 + 10 = Rs. 35 The cost price of 10 articles i.e. 20% of 50 = Rs. 10 The selling price of 10 articles at 20% profit = 10 + 20% of 10 ⇒ 10 + 2 = Rs. 12 The selling price of 40 articles ⇒ The cost price of 40 articles - the cost price of 7 articles ⇒ 40 - 7 = Rs. 33 Total SP=35+12+33=80 Profit = [IMG] ×100= [IMG] [IMG]

p75mock060.en: Sanjana borrows ₹2,40,000 at 18% per annum simple interest, and Savithri borrows ₹3,00,000 at 12% per annum simple interest. In how many years approximately will their amounts of debt be equal?
p75mock060.hi: संजना ₹ 2,40,000, 18% प्रति वर्ष की साधारण ब्याज दर पर उधार लेती है , और सावित्री ₹ 3,00,000, 12% प्रति वर्ष की साधारण ब्याज दर पर उधार लेती है। लगभग कितने वर्षों में उनके ऋण की राशि बराबर हो जाएगी ?
p75mock060.sol: Amount = Principal + SI [IMG] approximately 8 years.

p75mock060.en: Which of these is both an Integer and a Whole number?
p75mock060.hi: इनमें से कौन - सी संख्या पूर्णांक और पूर्ण संख्या , दोनों है ?
p75mock060.sol: Integers = --, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, -- Whole numbers = 0, 1, 2, 3, --- ⇒ ‘ 0’ (from options)

p75mock060.en: In [IMG] ABC, AB = 7cm, BC = 24cm and AC = 25cm. If G is the centroid of the triangle, then what is the length [in cm] of BG?
p75mock060.hi: ABC में , AB = 7 सेमी , BC = 24 सेमी और AC = 25 सेमी। यदि G त्रिभुज का केन्द्रक है , तो BG की लंबाई [ सेमी में ] क्या है ?
p75mock060.sol: [IMG] Also 7, 24, 25 is a triplet so ABC is right angle ∆ [IMG] BO = [IMG] [median of △ABC] And BO divides in 2:1 So, BG= [IMG] × [IMG] = [IMG] = [IMG] [IMG] साथ ही 7, 24, 25 एक त्रिक है इसलिए ABC समकोण ∆ है [IMG] BO = [IMG] [△ ABC की माध्यिका ] और BO 2:1 में विभाजित होता है इसलि ए , BG= [IMG] × [IMG] = [IMG] = [IMG]

p75mock060.en: The inner and outer radii of a hemispherical wooden bowl are 6 cm and 8 cm, respectively. Its entire surface has to be polished and the cost of polishing [IMG] cm² is ₹50. How much will it cost to polish the bowl?
p75mock060.hi: एक अर्धगोलाकार लकड़ी के कटोरे की आंतरिक और बाहरी त्रिज्याएँ क्रमशः 6 सेमी और 8 सेमी हैं। इसकी पूरी सतह को पॉलिश करना है और [IMG] cm² पॉलिश करने की लागत ₹ 50 है। कटोरे को पॉलिश करने में कितना खर्च आएगा ?
p75mock060.sol: Required Area to be polished = CSA of outer hemisphere + CSA Inner hemisphere + upper area of the ring part = 2πR² + 2πr² + π R² - π r² = 2π[R² + r²] + π( R² - r² ) = 2π[64 + 36] + π(64 - 36) = 2π × 100 + π × 28 = 228 π cm² Cost of π cm² = ₹50 ∴ Cost of 228π cm² = ₹50 × 228 = ₹11,400

p75mock060.en: In a school, the final grades of a subject for an academic year are calculated, based on the grades that a student gets in his assignments, tests and a final exam. Assignments have the weightage of 28%, tests of 22%, and the final exam of 50%. If a student has an assignment grade of 80, a test grade of 75, an exam grade of 86, then his overall grade for the year is_____________.
p75mock060.hi: किसी स्कूल में , एक शैक्षणिक वर्ष के लिए किसी विषय के अंतिम ग्रेड की गणना , छात्र द्वारा उसके असाइनमेंट , टेस्ट और अंतिम परीक्षा में प्राप्त ग्रेड के आधार पर की जाती है। असाइनमेंट का वेटेज 28%, टेस्ट का 22% और अंतिम परीक्षा का 50% होता है। यदि किसी छात्र का असाइनमेंट ग्रेड 80, टेस्ट ग्रेड 75, परीक्षा ग्रेड 86 है , तो वर्ष के लिए उसका कुल ग्रेड ____________ है।

p75mock060.en: Which of the following numbers leaves the remainder equal to the highest common factor of 6, 8 and 9, when divided by 6, 8 and 9?
p75mock060.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी संख्या को 6, 8 और 9 से विभाजित करने पर शेषफल 6, 8 और 9 के महत्तम समापवर्तक के बराबर बचता है ?
p75mock060.sol: H⋅C⋅F of [6,8,9]=1 LCM of [6,8,9]=72 Check options for number Divided by 72 leaves remainder equal to 1 Option D = 433

p75mock060.en: When operated separately, pipe A takes 5 hours less than pipe B to fill a cistern and when operated together, the cistern gets filled in 6 hours. In how much time [in hours] will pipe A fill the cistern, if operated separately?
p75mock060.hi: जब अलग - अलग संचालित किया जाता है , तो पाइप A को टंकी भरने में पाइप B से 5 घंटे कम लगते हैं और जब एक साथ संचालित किया जाता है , तो टंकी 6 घंटे में भर जाती है। यदि अलग - अलग संचालित किया जाता है , तो पाइप A टंकी को कितने समय [ घंटों में ] भरेगा ?
p75mock060.sol: Let time taken by A be x hours: ATQ: [IMG] = 6 ⇒ x 2 + 5x = 12x + 30 ⇒ x 2 - 7x - 30 = 0 ⇒ [x - 10][x + 3]= 0 ⇒ x =10 hours Time taken by A =10 hours

p75mock060.en: Find the values of x, y and z, so as to satisfy the equations given below: 5x – 3y + 7z = 22; 3x – 5y – 2z = -46; 2x – 2y + 5z = 24
p75mock060.hi: x, y और z के मान ज्ञात कीजिए , ताकि नीचे दिए गए समीकरण संतुष्ट हो जाएं : 5x – 3y + 7z = 22; 3x – 5y – 2z = -46; 2x – 2y + 5z = 24
p75mock060.sol: [IMG]

p75mock060.en: An alloy contains 40% of silver, 30% of copper and 30% of nickel. How much silver [in kg] should be added to 25 kg of the alloy so that the new alloy contains 50% of silver?
p75mock060.hi: एक मिश्र धातु में 40% चांदी , 30% तांबा और 30% निकल है। 25 किलोग्राम मिश्र धातु में कितनी चांदी [ किलोग्राम में ] मिलाई जानी चाहिए ताकि नए मिश्र धातु में 50% चांदी हो ?
p75mock060.sol: Weight of silver in 25 kg = 25 ×40%=10 kg Let the amount of silver added = a kg Then as per question, [10+a] = [IMG] [25+a] =20+2a=25+a = a= 5 kg Hence 5 kg silver is required to add in 25 kg alloy so that new alloy contains 50% of silver.

p75mock060.en: Which of the following numbers can possibly be a perfect square?
p75mock060.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन - सी संख्या संभावित रूप से एक पूर्ण वर्ग हो सकती है ?
p75mock060.sol: A perfect square always ends with 0, 1, 4, 7, 9 ⇒ Option 4 i.e 413344

p75mock060.en: A right circular cylinder having the radius of r and height of h is inscribed in a sphere. The sphere’s diameter is d. What is the relationship between the height of the cylinder h and its radius r in terms of the sphere’s diameter d?
p75mock060.hi: एक गोले के अंदर एक लंब वृत्तीय बेलन बना हुआ है , जिसकी त्रिज्या r और ऊँचाई h है। गोले का व्यास d है। गोले के व्यास d के पदों में , बेलन की ऊँचाई h और उसकी त्रिज्या r के बीच क्या संबंध है ?
p75mock060.sol: [IMG] Let diameter of the circle be 'd'. d²=h²+(2r)² d²=h²+4r² d²-4r²=h² √(d²-4r²)=h

p75mock060.en: The batting average for 27 innings of a cricket player is 47 runs. His highest score in an innings exceeds his lowest score by 157 runs. If these two innings are excluded, the average score of the remaining 25 innings is 42 runs. Find his highest score in an innings.
p75mock060.hi: एक क्रिकेट खिलाड़ी की 27 पारियों का बल्लेबाजी औसत 47 रन है। एक पारी में उसका उच्चतम स्कोर उसके न्यूनतम स्कोर से 157 रन अधिक है। यदि इन दो पारियों को छोड़ दिया जाए , तो शेष 25 पारियों का औसत स्कोर 42 रन है। एक पारी में उसका उच्चतम स्कोर ज्ञात कीजिए।
p75mock060.sol: Using deviation method Avg decrease by 47- 42 = 5 So, total Runs in two innings i.e. H+L = 47×2+25×5 H+ L = 219 H - L =157 {given} ∴ H= [IMG] =188 Runs.

p75mock060.en: In a mathematics club, the average score of 12 students is 70.5. After including the scores of 4 more students, the overall average becomes 75.0. If the scores of two of the new students are 78 and 82, and the remaining two have equal scores, find the score of each of the remaining two students.
p75mock060.hi: एक गणित क्लब में , 12 छात्रों का औसत स्कोर 70.5 है। 4 और छात्रों के स्कोर शामिल करने के बाद , कुल औसत 75.0 हो जाता है। यदि नए छात्रों में से दो के स्कोर 78 और 82 हैं , और बाकी दो के स्कोर बराबर हैं , तो बाकी बचे दोनों छात्रों में से प्रत्येक का स्कोर ज्ञात कीजिए।
p75mock060.sol: Let the 4 students be a, b, c, d 12×70.5+a+b+c+d=Sum (12×70.5+78+82+c+d)/(12+4) =75⇒Avg 846 + 160 + c + d = 16×75 c + d=1200-1006=194 Since, c & d have equal scores ∴ Each scored=194/2=97

p75mock060.hi: यदि {8 [IMG] +27 [IMG] } ÷ {2x + 3y} = {A [IMG] + Bxy + C [IMG] }, तो [5A + 4B + 3C] का मान है :

p75mock060.en: Eight persons can finish a work in 20 days. After 5 days they were requested to complete the work in the next 8 days. How many persons should join the group to fulfil the requirement?
p75mock060.hi: आठ व्यक्ति एक काम को 20 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। 5 दिनों के बाद उनसे अगले 8 दिनों में काम पूरा करने के लिए कहा गया। आवश्यकता को पूरा करने के लिए कितने व्यक्तियों को समूह में शामिल होना चाहिए ?
p75mock060.sol: According to the question 8 × 15 = M × 8 M=15 Additional persons =15 [IMG] 8=7

p75mock060.en: In the following figure, if angles [IMG] ABC = 95°, [IMG] FED = 115° [not to scale]. Then the angle [IMG] APC is equal to: [IMG]
p75mock060.hi: निम्नलिखित आकृति में , यदि कोण [IMG] ABC = 95°, [IMG] FED = 115° [ पैमाने के अनुसार नहीं ] । तो कोण [IMG] APC बराबर है : [IMG]

p75mock060.en: There is a rectangular plot, 120 m long and 98 m wide, with semi-circular flower beds along the breadth on both sides of the plot. The cost of putting a fence all around the plot at ₹16.50 per m is: [Take [IMG] = 22/7]
p75mock060.hi: एक आयताकार प्लॉट है , जो 120 मीटर लंबा और 98 मीटर चौड़ा है , जिसके दोनों तरफ चौड़ाई के साथ अर्ध - वृत्ताकार फूलों की क्यारियाँ हैं। प्लॉट के चारों ओर बाड़ लगाने की लागत ₹ 16.50 प्रति मीटर है : [ लेना = 22/7 ]
p75mock060.sol: [IMG] Perimeter of whale plot is πr + 120 + 120 + πr ⇒ 2πr + 240 =2 × [IMG] × [IMG] + 240 ⇒ 308 + 240 = 548m Total Cost of fencing = 548 × 16.5RS =9042 RS

p75mock060.en: N solid metallic spherical balls are melted and recast into a cylindrical rod whose radius is 3 times that of a spherical ball and height is 4 times the radius of a spherical ball. The value of N is:
p75mock060.hi: N ठोस धातु की गोलाकार गेंदों को पिघलाकर एक बेलनाकार छड़ में ढाला जाता है जिसकी त्रिज्या गोलाकार गेंद की त्रिज्या की 3 गुनी है और ऊँचाई गोलाकार गेंद की त्रिज्या की 4 गुनी है। N का मान है :
p75mock060.sol: Height of cylinder = 4 × Radius sphere = 4r Radius of cylinder =3 × Radius sphere =3r Volume of sphere = [IMG] πr 3 v. of cylinder = πr 2 h ⇒ N × [IMG] πr 3 = 1 × π × [3r] 2 × 4r ⇒ N = 27

p75mock060.en: The average of 26 numbers is zero. Of them, how many may be greater than zero, at the most?
p75mock060.hi: 26 संख्याओं का औसत शून्य है। उनमें से अधिकतम कितनी संख्याएँ शून्य से बड़ी हो सकती हैं ?
p75mock060.sol: If Avg of 26 Numbers is zero then their sum is also zero. For this, maximum 25 numbers are greater than zero & 26 th number may be Negative which sums up to zero.

p75mock061.en: If cosecθ – sin θ= 6, then what is the value of sinθ + cosecθ ?
p75mock061.hi: यदि cosecθ– sinθ= 6, तो sinθ + cosecθ का मान क्या है ?
p75mock061.sol: cosecθ – sinθ = 6 [IMG] – S= 6 [IMG] +S = [IMG] = [IMG] = [IMG]

p75mock061.en: Given that the lengths of the paths of a ball thrown with different speeds by two boys are the same, and that the average speed for the first and second throws are respectively 90km/h and 162 km/h. then what is the time taken by the first throw to cover the length if the same for the second thrown is one second?
p75mock061.hi: दिया गया है कि दो लड़कों द्वारा अलग - अलग गति से फेंकी गई गेंद के पथ की लंबाई समान है , तथा पहली और दूसरी फेंक की औसत गति क्रमशः 90 किमी / घंटा और 162 किमी / घंटा है। यदि दूसरी फेंकी गई गेंद के लिए लंबाई तय करने में एक सेकंड का समय लगता है , तो पहली फेंक द्वारा लंबाई तय करने में कितना समय लगेगा ?
p75mock061.sol: length [Distance] = speed [IMG] Time For same length 90 × t 1 =162 × 1 t 1 = [IMG] = [IMG] sec

p75mock061.en: In a 240-m race, A beats B by 24 m or 6 seconds. Which of the following options is equal to B’s time to complete the race?
p75mock061.hi: 240 मीटर की दौड़ में , A, B को 24 मीटर या 6 सेकंड से हरा देता है। निम्नलिखित में से कौन - सा विकल्प B द्वारा दौड़ पूरी करने में लिए गए समय के बराबर है ?
p75mock061.sol: B's speed = 24/6 = 4 m/s ⇒ time = 240/4 = 60 sec

p75mock061.en: A and B invest €80,000 and €1,20,000 respectively in a business. After one year, the profit is distributed, including simple interest at 10% per annum on the capital. The total amount received (capital + interest + profit) is €2,60,000. What is A’s share?
p75mock061.hi: A और B ने एक व्यवसाय में क्रमशः €80,000 और €1,20,000 निवेश किए । एक वर्ष बाद लाभ का वितरण किया गया , जिसमें पूंजी पर 10% वार्षिक साधारण ब्याज भी शामिल है । कुल प्राप्त राशि ( पूंजी + ब्याज + लाभ ) €2,60,000 है । A का हिस्सा कितना है ?
p75mock061.sol: Amount = 2,60,000, R% = 10% A = 80,000 , B = 1,20,000 A’s interest = 8,000; B ’ s interest =12,000 Total Interest = 20,000 Total Capital = 2,00,000 Sum = 2,20,000 Amount Rec ei ved = 2,60,000 ⇒ Profit = 2,60,000-2 , 20 , 000 = 40,000 Profit Ratio ⟶ A:B 2:3 ⇒ A's Profit =2×40000/5 = 16000 Total share of A = 80,000+8,000+16,000 = €1,04,000

p75mock061.en: Two circle each of radius 36 cm are intersecting each other such that each circle is passing through the centre of the other circle. What is the length of common chord to the two circles?
p75mock061.hi: 36 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले दो वृत्त एक दूसरे को इस प्रकार प्रतिच्छेद कर रहे हैं कि प्रत्येक वृत्त दूसरे वृत्त के केंद्र से होकर गुजर रहा है। दोनों वृत्तों की उभयनिष्ठ जीवा की लंबाई क्या है ?
p75mock061.sol: [IMG] PA = PB = AB [All are radius] ∴△ PAB = Equilateral △. PR = height of equilateral △ = [IMG] a = [IMG] × 36 = [IMG] Common chord PQ =2 × PR = 2 × 18√3 = 36√3

p75mock061.en: A can do a piece of work in 30 days, B in 50 days and C in 40 days. If A is assisted by B on one day and by C on the next day alternately, the work will be completed in:
p75mock061.hi: A किसी काम को 30 दिन में , B 50 दिन में तथा C 40 दिन में कर सकता है। यदि A को एक दिन B तथा अगले दिन C द्वारा बारी - बारी से सहायता दी जाए , तो काम कितने दिनों में पूरा होगा ?
p75mock061.sol: [IMG] Order to complete the work in alternate days = A+B, A+C 32 + 35 = 67 2 days = 67 work × 8 × 8 16 days = 536 17th day = 32 Work completed in 17 days = 536+32 = 568 On the 18 th day A+C will do the remaining work So the total work is completed in = 17+ [IMG] = [IMG] days

p75mock061.en: The ratio of boys to girls initially in a college is 5: 6. If 40 boys leave the college and 50 girls join the college, the ratio will become 8: 11. Find the number of girls [initial] in the college.
p75mock061.hi: एक कॉलेज में शुरुआत में लड़कों और लड़कियों का अनुपात 5: 6 है। यदि 40 लड़के कॉलेज छोड़ देते हैं और 50 लड़कियां कॉलेज में शामिल हो जाती हैं , तो अनुपात 8: 11 हो जाएगा। कॉलेज में लड़कियों की [ शुरुआत में ] संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।

p75mock061.en: In right angle [IMG] ABC where [IMG] A = 90 ̊ , AB = c cm, AC = b cm and CB = a cm. If [IMG] A = 2 [IMG] B, then which of the following is true?
p75mock061.hi: समकोण [IMG] ABC में जहां [IMG] A = 90 ̊ , AB = c सेमी , AC = b सेमी और CB = a सेमी है। यदि [IMG] A = 2 [IMG] B है , तो निम्न में से कौन सा सत्य है ?
p75mock061.sol: [IMG] Given that ∆ ABC is Right Angle triangle And ∠A = 2∠B Let ∠A = 90 ̊ then ∠B = 45 ̊ ∴ Now, BC 2 = AB 2 + AC 2 a 2 = b 2 + c 2 --- {1} Also, if ∠B =∠C, then AC = AB ⇒ b = c From eq n {1} a 2 = b 2 + c 2 a 2 = b 2 + bc

p75mock061.en: A horse is grazing in a field. It is tied to a pole with a rope of length 6 m. The horse moves from point A to point B making an arc with an angle of 70°. Find the area of the sector grazed by the horse.
p75mock061.hi: एक घोड़ा खेत में चर रहा है। उसे 6 मीटर लंबी रस्सी से एक खंभे से बांधा गया है। घोड़ा बिंदु A से बिंदु B तक 70° के कोण पर चाप बनाता हुआ घूमता है। घोड़े द्वारा चराए गए क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए ।
p75mock061.sol: Area of the sector grazed by the horse = [IMG] × πr 2 A= [IMG] × [IMG] × 6 × 6 A = 22m 2

p75mock061.en: The cost of 3 breads and 1 packet of juice at a certain store is ₹323.50. At the same store, the cost of 5 breads and 1 packet of juice is ₹433.50. What will be the cost of 2 breads and 2 packets of juice at this store?
p75mock061.hi: किसी दुकान पर 3 ब्रेड और 1 पैकेट जूस की कीमत ₹ 323.50 है। उसी दुकान पर 5 ब्रेड और 1 पैकेट जूस की कीमत ₹ 433.50 है। इस दुकान पर 2 ब्रेड और 2 पैकेट जूस की कीमत क्या होगी ?
p75mock061.sol: let bread be B and juice be J [IMG]

p75mock061.en: The speed of train A is 25 km/hr more than the speed of train B. A takes 4 hours less time to travel a distance of 300 km that what train B takes to travel 250 km. What is the speed [in km/hr] of A?
p75mock061.hi: ट्रेन A की गति ट्रेन B की गति से 25 किमी / घंटा अधिक है। A को 300 किमी की दूरी तय करने में ट्रेन B को 250 किमी की दूरी तय करने में लगने वाले समय से 4 घंटे कम समय लगता है। A की गति [ किमी / घंटा में ] क्या है ?
p75mock061.sol: Check by options, {B} Speed of A = 50 km/h and speed of B = 25 km/hr A takes 4 hours less time to travel a distance of 300 km that what train B takes to travel 250 km. ⇒ [IMG] – [IMG] = 4 ⇒ 10 – 6 = 4 ⇒ 4 = 4 {Satisfies the given condition} Or, [IMG] – [IMG] = 4 B = 25 Therefore, speed of A =50km/h

p75mock061.en: The average of marks obtained by S1 and S2 is 30 more than the average marks obtained by S2 and S3. If the marks obtained by S3 is 50, then what are the marks obtained by S1?
p75mock061.hi: S1 और S2 द्वारा प्राप्त अंकों का औसत S2 और S3 द्वारा प्राप्त औसत अंकों से 30 अधिक है। यदि S3 द्वारा प्राप्त अंक 50 हैं , तो S1 द्वारा प्राप्त अंक क्या हैं ?
p75mock061.sol: Let marks obtained by S 1 be ‘x’ as per question; ⇒ [IMG] [IMG] = 30 ⇒ x - 50 = 30 × 2 = 60 x =110

p75mock061.en: A solid cone of radius 7 cm and height 7 cm was melted along with two solid spheres of radius 7 cm each to form a solid cylinder of radius 7 cm. What is the curved surface area [in cm [IMG] ] of the cylinder? [Take [IMG] = 22/7]
p75mock061.hi: 7 सेमी त्रिज्या और 7 सेमी ऊँचाई वाले एक ठोस शंकु को 7 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले दो ठोस गोलों के साथ पिघलाकर 7 सेमी त्रिज्या वाला एक ठोस बेलन बनाया गया। बेलन का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल [ in cm [IMG] ] क्या है ? [ Take [IMG] = 22/7 ]
p75mock061.sol: V of cone +V of two spheres = Volume of cylinder ⇒ [IMG] × π × 7 × 7 × 7+ 2 × [IMG] × π × 7 × 7 × 7= π × 7 × 7 × h ⇒ h = 21cm CSA of cylinder =2πrh = 2 × [IMG] × 7 × 21 = 924 cm 2

p75mock061.en: If f{p} = sin [IMG] x+ cos [IMG] x, then find 6f{2} – 4f{4} + 10f {0} ?
p75mock061.hi: यदि f{p} = sin [IMG] x+ cos [IMG] x तो 6f{2} – 4f{4} + 10f {0} ज्ञात कीजिए।
p75mock061.sol: If f{p} = sin [IMG] x+ cos [IMG] x Then, f{0} = sin 2 x+ cos 2 x =1 F{2} = sin 4 x+ cos 4 x =1-2 sin 2 x cos 2 x F{4} = sin 6 x+ cos 6 x =1-3 sin 2 x cos 2 x Now required value : 6f{2} – 4f{4} + 10f {0} = 6 [ 1-2 sin 2 x cos 2 x] – 4[1-3 sin 2 x cos 2 x]+10×1 =6-12 sin 2 x cos 2 x-4+ 12 sin 2 x cos 2 x+10= 12

p75mock061.en: The intersection of Rational and Irrational numbers is:
p75mock061.hi: परिमेय और अपरिमेय संख्याओं का प्रतिच्छेद है :
p75mock061.sol: There is nothing common between Rational & Irrational numbers. ⇒ Empty

p75mock061.en: In the triangle given below, D and E are mid points of AF and AG respectively. F and G are mid points of AB and AC respectively. If DE = 2.4 cm, then BC is equal to: [IMG]
p75mock061.hi: नीचे दिए गए त्रिभुज में , D और E क्रमशः AF और AG के मध्य बिंदु हैं। F और G क्रमशः AB और AC के मध्य बिंदु हैं। यदि DE = 2.4 सेमी , तो BC बराबर है : [IMG]
p75mock061.sol: [IMG] By midpoint theorem FG = 2DE & BC = 2FG Therefore, FG = 2⋅4 × 2 = 4.8 And BC = FG × 2 = 4.8 × 2 BC=9.6cm

p75mock061.en: A sum of ₹18,000 is lent at 10% p.a. compound interest, compounded annually. What is the difference between the compound interest for 3 rd year and 4 th year. [in ₹]
p75mock061.hi: ₹18,000 की राशि 10% प्रति वर्ष चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज की दर पर उधार दी जाती है , जो वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होती है। तीसरे वर्ष और चौथे वर्ष के चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज के बीच क्या अंतर है ? [₹ में ]
p75mock061.sol: Effective rate of 2years, 3 years and 4 years at the rate of 10% is 21%, 33.1% and 46.41% compound interest for 3 rd year = 33.1% - 21% = 12.1% compound interest for 4 th year =46.41%-33.1% = 13.31% Required difference = 13.31% - 12.1% =1.21% The difference between the compound interest for 3 rd year and 4 th year = 18000×1.21% = ₹217.80

p75mock061.en: The average of 25 numbers is 64. The averages of the first 13 numbers and that of the last 13 numbers are 62.8 and 72.2, respectively. If the 12 th number is 61, and if the 12 th and 13 th numbers are excluded, then what is the average of the remaining numbers [correct to one decimal place]?
p75mock061.hi: 25 संख्याओं का औसत 64 है। पहली 13 संख्याओं और अंतिम 13 संख्याओं का औसत क्रमशः 62.8 और 72.2 है। यदि 12 वीं संख्या 61 है , और यदि 12 वीं और 13 वीं संख्याओं को निकाल दिया जाए , तो शेष संख्याओं का औसत क्या है [ एक दशमलव स्थान तक सही ] ?

p75mock061.en: A & B together earn €840 for a job. A works the whole time; B joins after the job is 25 % done. B is twice as efficient as A. Find B's share.
p75mock061.hi: A और B मिलकर किसी काम के लिए € 840 कमाते हैं। A पूरे समय काम करता है ; B तब काम में शामिल होता है जब काम 25% पूरा हो चुका होता है। B, A से दोगुना कुशल है। B का हिस्सा ज्ञात कीजिए।
p75mock061.sol: [IMG] [IMG]

p75mock061.en: ΔABC is an equilateral triangle and AD⊥BC, where D lies on BC. If AD = [IMG] cm, then what is the perimeter [in cm] of ΔABC?
p75mock061.hi: Δ ABC एक समबाहु त्रिभुज है और AD ⊥ BC, जहाँ D, BC पर स्थित है। यदि AD = [IMG] सेमी है , तो Δ ABC का परिमाप [ सेमी में ] क्या है ?
p75mock061.sol: [IMG] In Equilateral ∆ Height = [IMG] × Side [IMG] = [IMG] × Side Side = 8cm Perimeter = 8 × 3 = 24cm

p75mock061.en: A boat running upstream takes 10 hours to cover a certain distance, while it takes 7 hours to cover the same distance running downstream. What is the ratio between the speed of the boat and that of the water current, respectively?
p75mock061.hi: धारा के प्रतिकूल चलने वाली एक नाव को एक निश्चित दूरी तय करने में 10 घंटे लगते हैं , जबकि धारा के अनुकूल चलने वाली नाव को समान दूरी तय करने में 7 घंटे लगते हैं। नाव की गति और जलधारा के बीच क्रमशः अनुपात क्या है ?
p75mock061.sol: Speed→ Upstream: Downstream = 7 : 10 Required ratio = [IMG] : [IMG] = 17: 3

p75mock061.en: Pipes P and Q can completely fill a water tank in 10 hours and 15 hours, respectively. A pipe R can empty a tank filled completely with water in 12 hours. Initially, the tank is empty and only pipes P and Q are opened at 6 a.m. and pipe R is also opened at 9 a.m. By what time will the tank be completely filled?
p75mock061.hi: पाइप P और Q एक पानी की टंकी को क्रमशः 10 घंटे और 15 घंटे में पूरी तरह से भर सकते हैं। एक पाइप R पानी से पूरी तरह से भरी हुई टंकी को 12 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। शुरुआत में , टंकी खाली है और केवल पाइप P और Q को सुबह 6 बजे खोला जाता है और पाइप R को भी सुबह 9 बजे खोला जाता है। कितने समय तक टंकी पूरी तरह से भर जाएगी ?
p75mock061.sol: [IMG] Work = Efficiency × Time ⇒ 60 = [6 + 4] × 3 + [6 + 4 [IMG] 5] × t ⇒ 30 = 5 × t ⇒ t = 6 hours Required Time = 6 + 3 = 9 hours The tank will be filled at 6 am + 9 hours = 3 pm.

p75mock062.en: The number 823p2q is exactly divisible by 7, 11 and 13. What is the value of [p – q]?
p75mock062.hi: संख्या 823p2q, 7, 11 और 13 से पूर्णतः विभाज्य है। [p – q] का मान क्या है ?
p75mock062.sol: LCM of 13,7 and 11 = 1001 abc×1001 = abcabc 823p2q = abcabc [compare] a=8, b =2 and c= 3 p-q = 8-3 = 5

p75mock062.en: PORS is a cyclic quadrilateral in which PQ = x cm, QR =16.8 cm, RS =14cm, PS = 25.2 cm & PR bisects QS. What is the value of x?
p75mock062.hi: PORS एक चक्रीय चतुर्भुज है जिसमें PQ = x सेमी , QR = 16.8 सेमी , RS = 14 सेमी , PS = 25.2 सेमी और PR, QS को समद्विभाजित करता है। x का मान क्या है ?
p75mock062.sol: [IMG] ⇒ PS × SR = PQ × RQ ⇒ 25.2 × 14 =16.8 × x ⇒ x = [IMG] =21cm

p75mock062.en: In an obtuse-angled triangle ABC, the length of its longest side AB is 50 cm and one of the other two sides is 42 cm. If the area of the triangle is 294 cm 2 , what is the length [in cm] of its third side?
p75mock062.hi: एक अधिक कोण त्रिभुज ABC में , इसकी सबसे लंबी भुजा AB की लंबाई 50 सेमी है और अन्य दो भुजाओं में से एक की लंबाई 42 सेमी है। यदि त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल 294 cm 2 है , तो इसकी तीसरी भुजा की लंबाई [ सेमी में ] क्या है ?

p75mock063.sol: Let two number be 21a and 21b First number × Second number = HCF × LCM 21a × 21b = 21 × 4641 ab = 221 ab = 13 × 17 a = 13 and b = 17 The first number = 21a = 21 × 13 = 273 Second number = 21b = 21 × 17 = 357 Sum of digit of 357 = 3 + 5 + 7 = 15.

p75mock064.sol: When cuboid is inscribed in a sphere, its longest diagonal (space diagonal) is equal to diameter of the sphere Therefore, cuboid diagonal =2×20cm=40cm Using formula, d²=l²+b²+h² 40²=21²+28²+h² 1600=441+784+h² 1600=1225+h² h=√375=5√15 Third dimension =5√15 cm.

Divisibility of 8: The last 3 digit of number must be divisible by 8. 2y4 must be divisible by 8 If y=1, 214 is not divisible by 8 Then, y=2, 224 is divisible by 8 y=6, 264is divisible by 8 [largest possible value] x894264 is divisible by 7 So, dividing the above number by 7, remainder →x+0 ∴ x=7 [IMG] +y = [IMG] + 6 = 55

p75mock068.sol: discount given by A = 20 + 20 – [IMG] = 36% discount given by B = 25 + 15 – [IMG] = 36.25% discount given by C = 30 + 10 – [IMG] = 37% maximum discount is given by C i.e. = 4820 [IMG] = 1783.40 Hence, option D is correct.

p75mock068.en: A person marks his 40 items at 20% above the cost price. He sells 10 items at a 10% discount and 20 items at a 15% discount on the market price. What is the maximum discount [rounded off] he can offer on the remaining items if he still gets some profit?

p75mock068.sol: Let CP of 1 Article =100 then CP of 40 At. =4000 MP of 1 Article =100× [IMG] =120 S.P of 10 Article =1200× [IMG] =1080 S.P of 20 Article =2400× [IMG] =2040 M.P of 10 Article =1200 Total S.P of 40 Art =1080+2040+1200=4320 ∴ He can afford to give discount of Rs:4320-4000 =320 D%= [IMG] ×100= [IMG] %=26.66%∼26%

p75mock068.en: [IMG] ABC is inscribed in a circle with center O, such that [IMG] ACB = 115°. O is joined to A. What is the measure of [IMG] OAB?

p75mock068.en: A father’s age at the time of the birth of his son is the same as the present age of the son. If the age of the son was 15 years five years ago, then what is the current age of the father?
p75mock068.hi: एक पिता की आयु उसके बेटे के जन्म के समय बेटे की वर्तमान आयु के बराबर है। यदि पाँच वर्ष पहले बेटे की आयु 15 वर्ष थी , तो पिता की वर्तमान आयु क्या है ?
p75mock068.sol: Father’s age would be = 2 × son Son age today =15 + 5 = 20 yrs Father =20 × 2 = 40 yrs

p75mock068.en: 10 women take 16 days to complete a work which can be completed by 6 men in 8 days. 12 men started working and after 2 days 6 men left and 5 women joined them. In how many days will the remaining work be completed?

p75mock068.sol: 10w × 16 = 6m × 8 W : M = 3:10 Total Work = 10 × 3 × 16 = 480 Let required number of days = n Then as per ques → [12 × 10]2 + [6 × 10 + 5 × 3]n = 480 n = [IMG]

p75mock068.en: A certain sum becomes 5 times itself in 10 years at simple interest. In how many years will it become 15 times itself at the same rate of interest?
p75mock068.hi: कोई निश्चित राशि साधारण ब्याज पर 10 वर्षों में स्वयं की 5 गुना हो जाती है। उसी ब्याज दर पर , वह कितने वर्षों में स्वयं की 15 गुना हो जाएगी ?
p75mock068.sol: 1 → 5 in 10 years this means, 400% increase in 10 year 400% ⟶ 10 year To become 15 times of itself, need 1400% increase Now, 1% → 10/400 years 1400% → 10/400 × 1400 = 35 years

p75mock069.en: What is the total number of factors of the number 840 except 1 and the number itself?

p75mock069.en: The average age of Ram and Shyam is 28 years. If Rahim replaces Ram, then the average age will become 26 years. If Rahim replaces Shyam, then the average age will become 30 years. What are the respective ages of Ram, Shyam and Rahim?
p75mock069.hi: राम और श्याम की औसत आयु 28 वर्ष है। यदि रहीम राम की जगह ले ले , तो औसत आयु 26 वर्ष हो जाएगी। यदि रहीम श्याम की जगह ले ले , तो औसत आयु 30 वर्ष हो जाएगी। राम , श्याम और रहीम की क्रमशः आयु क्या है ?
p75mock069.sol: Sum of age of Ram & Shyam = 2×28=56yrs Sum of age of Rahim & Shyam = 2×26 = 52 years Sum of age of Rahim & Ram = 2 × 30 = 60yrs Sum of age of all three = [IMG] = 84 ∴ Age of Ram = 84 - 52 = 32yrs Age of Shyam =84 [IMG] 60 = 24 yrs Age of Rahim 84 - 56 = 28 yrs

p75mock069.en: If the semi-perimeter and area of a rectangular whose length and breadth are 'x' and 'y' is 12 cm and 28 cm 2 , respectively, then find the value of x 4 + y 4 + x 2 y 2

p75mock070.en: Speed of a train is 30 percent more than the speed of a car. Both start from point P at the same time and reach point Q at the same time. P and Q are 130 km apart from each other. On the way train stops for 30 minutes at a station. What is the speed of the train?
p75mock070.hi: एक रेलगाड़ी की गति एक कार की गति से 30 प्रतिशत अधिक है। दोनों एक ही समय पर बिंदु P से चलना शुरू करते हैं और एक ही समय पर बिंदु Q पर पहुँचते हैं। P और Q एक दूसरे से 130 किमी दूर हैं। रास्ते में रेलगाड़ी एक स्टेशन पर 30 मिनट के लिए रुकती है। रेलगाड़ी की गति क्या है ?
p75mock070.sol: Distance between them is 130 km Let the speed of train and car =13 : 10 [IMG] - [IMG] = 0.5 [IMG] = 6 So the speed of train =13x 13 × 6 =78 km/hr

p75mock071.en: The area of a field in the shape of a regular hexagon is [IMG] . The cost of fencing the field at ₹16.80/metre is:
p75mock071.hi: एक नियमित षट्भुज के आकार के मैदान का क्षेत्रफल [IMG] है। ₹ 16.80/ मीटर की दर से मैदान पर बाड़ लगाने की लागत है :
p75mock071.sol: Let side of Hexagon Field = a Now; Area = 6 × [IMG] × a 2 =2400 [IMG] ⇒ a 2 =1600 a = 40 Perimeter = 6a = 6 × 40 =240m Cost of fencing =16.80 × 240 = 4032₹

p75mock071.en: A rectangular tank measures 15 cm long, 12 cm wide and 8 cm high. If a spherical ball of largest possible size is placed inside this tank, what is the volume of the space not occupied by this ball?
p75mock071.hi: एक आयताकार टैंक 15 cm लंबा , 12 cm चौड़ा और 8 cm ऊँचा है। यदि इस टैंक के अंदर सबसे बड़े संभव आकार की एक गोलाकार गेंद रखी जाती है , तो उस जगह का आयतन कितना होगा जो इस गेंद द्वारा नहीं घेरा गया है ?
p75mock071.sol: For the ball to fit, its diameter cannot exceed the smallest dimension of the tank. Smallest dimension =8cm Maximum diameter =8cm Radius of sphere =4cm Volume of tank =15×12×8cm³ =1440cm³ Volume of Ball (sphere) =4/3 πr³ =4/3 π×4×4×4cm³ =256/3 πcm³ Volume not occupied =(1440-256/3 π) cm³

p75mock071.en: In a constituency 55% is the male and 40% of the total number of the males are illiterate and 40% of the females are literate, then by what percentage is the number of illiterate females more than that of the illiterate males [correct to one decimal place]?
p75mock071.hi: एक निर्वाचन क्षेत्र में 55% पुरुष हैं और कुल पुरुषों की संख्या का 40% निरक्षर हैं और 40% महिलाएं साक्षर हैं , तो निरक्षर महिलाओं की संख्या निरक्षर पुरुषों की संख्या से कितने प्रतिशत अधिक है [ एक दशमलव स्थान तक सही ]?
p75mock071.sol: Total population = 1000 Male = 550 Female = 450 Illiterate male =550×40%=220 Literate male =550-220=330 Literate female =40% of 450 = 180 Illiterate female =450-180=270 [IMG] ×100=22.7%

p75mock071.en: A person borrows ₹1,00,000 from a bank at 10% per annum simple interest and clears the debt in five years. If the instalment paid at the end of the first, second, third and fourth years to clear the debt are ₹10,000, ₹20,000, ₹30,000 and ₹40,000, respectively, what amount should be paid at the end of the fifth year to clear the debt?
p75mock071.hi: एक व्यक्ति बैंक से 10% प्रति वर्ष साधारण ब्याज पर ₹ 1,00,000 उधार लेता है और पाँच वर्षों में ऋण चुका देता है। यदि ऋण चुकाने के लिए पहले , दूसरे , तीसरे और चौथे वर्ष के अंत में भुगतान की गई किश्तें क्रमशः ₹ 10,000, ₹20,000, ₹30,000 और ₹ 40,000 हैं , तो ऋण चुकाने के लिए पाँचवें वर्ष के अंत में कितनी राशि चुकानी चाहिए ?
p75mock071.sol: 1 st year Interest =1,00,000×10%=10,000 Principal amount after 1 st yr =1,00,000-10,000=90,000 2 nd year Interest =90000×10%=9000 Similarly; Principal after 2 nd yr 90,000-20,000=70,000 3 rd year Interest =70000×10%=7000 Principal after 3 rd yr=70,000-30,000=40,000 4th year interest=4000 ∴ at the end of 5 th yr, total interest {1,00,000+90,000+70,000+40,000}×10% ⇒ 10,000+9000+7000+4000=30,000Ans

p75mock071.en: The simple interest on a sum of Rs. 4,800 for [IMG] years at a certain rate per annum is 1,684.80. What will be the amount of the same sum at the same rate for [IMG] years at simple interest?
p75mock071.hi: 4,800 रुपये की राशि पर [IMG] वर्षों के लिए एक निश्चित वार्षिक दर से साधारण ब्याज 1,684.80 है। उसी राशि पर [IMG] वर्षों के लिए समान दर से साधारण ब्याज क्या होगा ?
p75mock071.sol: [IMG] r = 1684.80 r = 7.8% Now; SI = 4800 [IMG] Amount = 4800 + 2496 = 7296 Hence option C is correct.

p75mock071.en: A triangular sail has a base 12 m and height 9 m. To increase its area by 20% without changing the base, by what percent must the height increase?
p75mock071.hi: एक तिकोने पाल का आधार 12 m और ऊँचाई 9 m है। आधार को बिना बदले , इसके क्षेत्रफल को 20% बढ़ाने के लिए , इसकी ऊँचाई को कितने प्रतिशत बढ़ाना होगा ?

p75mock071.en: A vertical pole and a vertical tower are on the same level ground in such a way that, from the top of the pole, the angel of elevation of the top of the tower is 60° and the angle of depression of the bottom of the tower is 30°. If the height of the pole is 24 m, then find the height of the tower [in m].
p75mock071.hi: एक ऊर्ध्वाधर खंभा और एक ऊर्ध्वाधर टावर समतल जमीन पर इस प्रकार स्थित हैं कि खंभे के शीर्ष से टावर के शीर्ष का उन्नयन कोण 60° है तथा टावर के आधार का अवनमन कोण 30° है। यदि खंभे की ऊँचाई 24 मीटर है, तो टावर की ऊँचाई (मीटर में) ज्ञात कीजिए।
p75mock071.sol: [IMG] ∴ 1 unit ----- 24 m Hight of tower is 4 unit 4 unit → 4 × 24 = 96 m Hence option C is correct

p75mock071.en: A and B leave from point M at the same time towards point N. B reaches N and starts towards M instantly. He meets A at point O [between M and N]. The distance between M and N is 245 km. If the speeds of A and B are 26 km/h and 65 km/h, respectively, then what is the distance between O and N?
p75mock071.hi: A और B एक ही समय पर बिंदु M से बिंदु N की ओर प्रस्थान करते हैं। B N पर पहुँचता है और तुरंत M की ओर चल पड़ता है। वह बिंदु O [M और N के बीच ] पर A से मिलता है। M और N के बीच की दूरी 245 किमी है। यदि A और B की गति क्रमशः 26 किमी / घंटा और 65 किमी / घंटा है , तो O और N के बीच की दूरी क्या है ?
p75mock071.sol: Time taken by B to reach N = [IMG] hours = [IMG] By the time B reaches N, distance cover by A = [IMG] × 26 = 98 km When B was at N, the distance between B and A = 245 - 98 = 147 km Time taken to meet each other at O = [IMG] = [IMG] hours Now, the distance between O and N = [IMG] × 65 = 105 km

p75mock071.en: A mask manufacturing company manufactured 'X’ number of masks in 2018. It increased its manufacturing capacity by 30% in 2019 and its further increased manufacturing by 15% in 2020. In 2021, due to the machinery breakdown, its manufacturing declined by 40%. What is the value of 'X' if it manufactured 179400 masks in 2021?
p75mock071.hi: एक मास्क बनाने वाली कंपनी ने 2018 में 'X' संख्या में मास्क बनाए। इसने 2019 में अपनी विनिर्माण क्षमता में 30% की वृद्धि की और 2020 में इसके विनिर्माण में 15% की वृद्धि की। 2021 में , मशीनरी के खराब होने के कारण , इसके विनिर्माण में 40% की गिरावट आई। 'X' का मान क्या है यदि इसने 2021 में 179400 मास्क बनाए ?

p75mock071.en: If the volume of one brick is 0.0014 m³, then how many bricks will be required to construct a wall of length 14 m, breadth 0.125 m and height 5 m? यदि एक ईंट का आयतन 0.0014 m³ है , तो 14 मीटर लम्बी , 0.125 मीटर चौड़ी तथा 5 मीटर ऊँची दीवार बनाने के लिए कितनी ईंटों की आवश्यकता होगी ?
p75mock071.hi: यदि एक ईंट का आयतन 0.0014 m³ है , तो 14 मीटर लम्बी , 0.125 मीटर चौड़ी तथा 5 मीटर ऊँची दीवार बनाने के लिए कितनी ईंटों की आवश्यकता होगी ?
p75mock071.sol: Let the number of brick be ‘n’ ⇒ n × volume of a brick = volume of wall ⇒ n × 0.0014 =14 ×0.125 ×5 n = 6250

p75mock071.en: A jar contains a mixture of milk and water, having 50% water. A part of this mixture is replaced by another mixture having 29% water. The percentage of water in the jar after replacement is 36%. What fraction of the original mixture was replaced?

p75mock071.en: If a sum amounts to ₹2,190 in four years and ₹2,409 in five years at compound interest, when the interest is compounded yearly, then the annual rate of interest is:
p75mock071.hi: यदि कोई धनराशि चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर चार वर्षों में ₹ 2,190 तथा पाँच वर्षों में ₹ 2,409 हो जाती है , जबकि ब्याज वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है , तो वार्षिक ब्याज दर क्या होगी ?
p75mock071.sol: Amount = [IMG] [IMG] = [IMG] = [IMG] r = 10%

p75mock071.en: Ram invested 45% of his salary in a scheme for 3 years which offers 10% per annum compound interest, compounded annually. If he receives ₹5,958 as total interest, then find Ram's salary?
p75mock071.hi: राम ने अपने वेतन का 45% 3 साल के लिए एक योजना में निवेश किया , जो सालाना 10% चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज प्रदान करती है। यदि उसे कुल ब्याज के रूप में ₹ 5,958 मिलते हैं , तो राम का वेतन ज्ञात कीजिए ?

p75mock071.en: A company placed an order for 24 high-end laptops and some quantity of standard desktops. The price of a high-end laptop was 4 times that of a standard desktop. Due to a mistake, the number of laptops and desktops was interchanged in the delivery. This caused the total bill to increase by 60%. What was the ratio of the number of high-end laptops to standard desktops in the original order?
p75mock071.hi: एक कंपनी ने 24 हाई - एंड लैपटॉप और कुछ मानक डेस्कटॉप का ऑर्डर दिया । एक हाई - एंड लैपटॉप की कीमत एक मानक डेस्कटॉप की कीमत का 4 गुना थी । गलती के कारण , डिलीवरी में लैपटॉप और डेस्कटॉप की संख्या उलट दी गई । इससे कुल बिल 60% बढ़ गया।मूल ऑर्डर में हाई - एंड लैपटॉप और मानक डेस्कटॉप की संख्या का अनुपात क्या था ?
p75mock071.sol: Laptops Desktops Actual = 24 x Mistake = x 24 Price = 4 ∶ 1 Actual Bill =24×4a + x×a = 96a×xa -------- 1 By mistake Bill = x×4a+24xa = 4xa+24a --- 2 1÷2 → 16/10 = { (4x+ 24)a } / { (96+ x)a } → x = 54 → Ratio → 24:54 or 4:9

p75mock071.en: Krishna bought a computer and paid 25% less than its original price. He sold it at 48% profit on the price he had paid. Find the percentage of profit earned by Krishna on the original price.
p75mock071.hi: कृष्णा ने एक कंप्यूटर खरीदा और इसकी मूल कीमत से 25% कम भुगतान किया। उसने इसे अपने द्वारा भुगतान की गई कीमत पर 48% लाभ पर बेचा। कृष्णा द्वारा मूल कीमत पर अर्जित लाभ का प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।
p75mock071.sol: let Original Price = 100 CP = 75 SP =75 [IMG] SP = 111 Profit% on Original Price = [IMG] 100 =11%

p75mock071.en: A shopkeeper purchases 500 kg of rice at ₹60 per kg. He sells the entire stock at ₹60 per kg but uses a weight of 800 grams instead of 1 kg while selling. After selling all the rice this way, he sells the rice saved through cheating in the black market and makes a total profit of ₹30,000. Find the ratio of the black-market price per kg to the original selling price per kg.
p75mock071.hi: एक दुकानदार 500 किग्रा चावल ₹60 प्रति किग्रा की दर से खरीदता है । वह पूरे स्टॉक को ₹60 प्रति किग्रा में बेचता है , लेकिन बिक्री के दौरान 1 किग्रा के बजाय 800 ग्राम का वजन इस्तेमाल करता है । इस तरह सभी चावल बेचने के बाद , वह धोखाधड़ी से बचाए गए चावल को काले बाजार में बेचता है और कुल ₹30,000 का लाभ कमाता है।काला बाजार में प्रति किग्रा मूल्य और मूल विक्रय मूल्य प्रति किग्रा का अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए ।
p75mock071.sol: Actual Rice Given = 0.8 × 500 = 400 Kg Rice saved = 500-400 = 100 Kg Total CP = 500 × 60 = 30,000 (Money collected) Cost of rice actually given = 400 × 60=24,000 Gain by cheating = 30K-24K = 6,000 Total Profit = 30,000 = 24000

p75mock071.en: On selling an article for ₹246.80. the gain is 20% more than the amount of loss incurred on selling it for ₹216. If the article is sold for ₹220.75, then what is the gain/loss percent [correct to nearest integer]?
p75mock071.hi: किसी वस्तु को ₹ 246.80 में बेचने पर , उसे ₹ 216 में बेचने पर होने वाली हानि की तुलना में लाभ 20% अधिक है। यदि वस्तु को ₹ 220.75 में बेचा जाता है , तो लाभ / हानि प्रतिशत क्या है [ निकटतम पूर्णांक तक सही ] ?

p75mock071.en: For a triangle with one interior angle more than, 90 0 where is its Orthocenter located?
p75mock071.hi: एक ऐसे त्रिभुज के लिए जिसका एक आंतरिक कोण 90° से अधिक हो , उसका लंबकेंद्र कहाँ स्थित होता है ?
options: At one of the vertices of the triangle.
At one of the sides of the triangle.
p75mock071.sol: One angle greater than 90°. Thus triangle is obtuse and In an obtuse angled triangle Orthocenter lies outside the triangle.

p75mock071.en: 6 copies of a book can be bought for a certain sum payable at the end of a year, and 7 copies of the same book can be bought for the same sum in cash money. What is the rate per annum of simple interest [correct to one decimal place]?
p75mock071.hi: एक वर्ष के अंत में देय एक निश्चित राशि पर एक पुस्तक की 6 प्रतियाँ खरीदी जा सकती हैं , तथा उसी पुस्तक की 7 प्रतियाँ उसी राशि पर नकद में खरीदी जा सकती हैं। साधारण ब्याज की वार्षिक दर [ एक दशमलव स्थान तक सही ] क्या है ?
p75mock071.sol: As per question; 1 book is charged as Interest on 6 books for a year ∴ Rate = [IMG] ×100=16.67%

p75mock072.en: In an election, a candidate secures 42% of the votes polled but is defeated by his only opponent by a majority of 3080 votes, because of 1400 invalid votes. The percentage of invalid votes is
p75mock072.hi: एक चुनाव में , एक उम्मीदवार को डाले गए कुल मतों का 42% प्राप्त होता है , लेकिन 1400 अवैध मतों के कारण वह अपने एकमात्र प्रतिद्वंद्वी से 3080 मतों के बहुमत से हार जाता है। अवैध मतों का प्रतिशत है:
p75mock072.sol: Let total votes polled = 100x Invalid votes = 1400 Valid = 100x – 1400 Loser candidate got = 42% = 42x Winner = 100x – 1400 – 42x = 58x – 1400 Difference = 58x – 1400 – 42x = 3080 x = 280 so 100x= 28000 % of invalid votes = [IMG] 100 = 5%

p75mock073.en: Anand covers a certain distance in the first lag of 5 hours at the speed of 50 km/h. p75mock073.en: What is the sum of the numbers between 400 and 500 such that when they are divided by 6,12 and 16, it leaves no remainder?

p75mock073.sol: Let average age of 18 players be A. Average 3 years ago = A – 3 Let sum of ages of newcomers be B. ATQ, (18A-6×30+B)/18=(A-3) B = 180-54=126 Average of B = 126/6=21

p75mock073.en: A and B can complete a work in 15 days and 10 days respectively. They started doing the work together but after 4 days B had to leave. Then A working with a new worker C completed the remaining work in 3 days. If C works alone, in how many days he can do 40% of the same work?
p75mock073.hi: A और B किसी काम को क्रमशः 15 दिन और 10 दिन में पूरा कर सकते हैं। उन्होंने साथ मिलकर काम करना शुरू किया लेकिन 4 दिन बाद B को काम छोड़ना पड़ा। फिर A ने नए कर्मचारी C के साथ काम करके शेष काम 3 दिन में पूरा किया। यदि C अकेले काम करता है , तो वह उसी काम का 40% कितने दिन में पूरा कर सकता है ?
p75mock073.sol: A=15 B=10 > 30 2 3 [IMG] A & B work for 4 days = 5 × 4 =20 Work left = 30 - 20 =10 Remaining work completed by A & C in 3 days Efficiency of C = x [IMG] = 3 ; so, x = [IMG] 40% of the work = [IMG] =12 If C work alone time taken by him to complete 40% of work = [IMG] = 9 days

p75mock074.en: The length, breadth and height of a hall are 10 m, 20 m and 15m respectively. Find the cost of whitewashing the walls of the inside of the hall and ceiling at the rate of ₹10.20/m²
p75mock074.hi: एक हॉल की लंबाई , चौड़ाई और ऊंचाई क्रमशः 10 मीटर , 20 मीटर और 15 मीटर है। हॉल के अंदर की दीवारों और छत पर 10.20 रुपये प्रति वर्ग मीटर की दर से सफेदी कराने की लागत ज्ञात कीजिए।

p75mock074.sol: Let four consecutive odd natural numbers =[x- 2] , x , x+2 , x+4 Then Average = [IMG] = [x+1] & Three consecutive even natural numbers = y - 2 , y , y+2 Then Average = [IMG] =y A⋅T⋅Q; x+1= y- 8 x [IMG] y = - 9 …..{1} Given that, 4x + 4 = 3y 4x - 3y = - 4……{2} On Solving {1] & {2}, We set x=23, y=32 ∴ Avg of odd numbers =x+1=23+1=24

p75mock074.en: [IMG] = ?
p75mock074.hi: [IMG] = ?
p75mock074.sol: \(\begin{aligned} &= \sqrt{\frac{cosec A + 1}{cosec A - 1}} + \sqrt{\frac{cosec A - 1}{cosec A + 1}} \\ &= \sqrt{\frac{1 + \sin A}{1 - \sin A}} + \sqrt{\frac{1 - \sin A}{1 + \sin A}} \\ &= \sqrt{\frac{(1 + \sin A)^2}{1 - \sin^2 A}} + \sqrt{\frac{(1 - \sin A)^2}{1 - \sin^2 A}} \\ &= \frac{1 + \sin A}{\cos A} + \frac{1 - \sin A}{\cos A} \\ &= \frac{2}{\cos A} = 2\sec A \end{aligned}\)

p75mock074.sol: Let the usual speed of Akhil =xkm/h According to the question [IMG] - [IMG] = [IMG] [IMG] = [IMG] [IMG] = [IMG] x 2 - 10x = 1500 ×2 x 2 - 10x - 3000 = 0 [x - 60 ] [ x + 50 ] = 0 x = 60 Time taken after 15km/h slower Speed = [IMG] = [IMG] = 2hr

p75mock074.en: The distance between two places A and B is 140 km. Two cars x and y start simultaneously from A and B, respectively. If they move in the same direction, they meet after 7 hours. p75mock074.sol: If they move towards each other, they meet after one hour [a + b] = [IMG] ⇒ [a + b] = 140 ----{1} If they move in the same direction, they meet after 7 hours. ⇒ [a – b] = [IMG] ⇒ [a – b] = 20 ----{2} From equation {1} and equation {2} we get ⇒ a = [IMG] = 80 So, speed of y car = 80 km/hr

p75mock075.en: The sum of 3-digit numbers abc, cab and bca is not divisible by: 3- अंकीय संख्याओं abc, cab और bca का योग किससे विभाज्य नहीं है ?
p75mock075.hi: 3- अंकीय संख्याओं abc, cab और bca का योग किससे विभाज्य नहीं है ?
p75mock075.sol: Expanded form of abc = 100×a+10×b+1×c = 100a+10b+c Expanded form of cab = 100×c+10×a+1×b = 100c+10a+b Expanded form of bca = 100×b+10×c+1×a = 100b+10c+a 100a+10b+c+ 100c+10a+b+100b+10c+a = 111{a+b+c} 111{a+b+c} is divisible by 37, 3 and {a+b+c} Clearly it is not divisible by 31.

p75mock075.en: Sides AB and DC of a cyclic quadrilateral ABCD are produced to meet at E, and sides AD and BC are produced to meet at F. If [IMG] ADC = 75° and [IMG] BEC = 52°, then the difference between [IMG] BAD and [IMG] AFB is:

p75mock075.sol: [IMG] In △AED ∠ DAE = 180 ̊ - [75 ̊ + 52 ̊] = 53 ̊ In cyclic quadrilateral ABCD ∠ B = 180 ̊ - 75 ̊ = 105 ̊ In △AFB ∠ AFB = 180 ̊ - [105 ̊ + 53 ̊] = 22 ̊ Difference = ∠BAD - ∠AFB = 53 ̊ - 22 ̊= 31 ̊

p75mock075.en: The difference between the two perpendicular sides of a right-angled triangle is 17 cm and its area is 84 cm². What is the perimeter [in cm] of the t riangle?

p75mock075.en: A display stand is shaped like a right triangular prism. The triangular base is a right-angles triangle with perpendicular sides measuring 5 cm and 12 cm. p75mock075.sol: Using Pythagoras theorem, Hypotenuse =√(5²+12²)=13cm. Height of prism =8cm A triangular prism has 3 rectangular faces formed by: each side of triangle × prism height Areas: 5×8=40cm² 12×8=96cm² 13×8=104cm² Ratio of largest to smallest rectangular face ⇒104:40 ⇒13:5

p75mock076.en: Consider the following two statements, labelled Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Evaluate them and choose the appropriate answer from the given options. Assertion (A): Every composite number greater than one can be written as the result of multiplying prime numbers together. Reason (R): The Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic guarantees unique prime factorizations for all integers greater than 1
p75mock076.hi: निम्नलिखित दो कथनों पर विचार कीजिए , जिन्हें कथन (A) और कारण (R) के रूप में चिह्नित किया गया है। उनका मूल्यांकन कीजिए और दिए गए विकल्पों में से उचित उत्तर चुनिए। कथन (A): 1 से बड़ी प्रत्येक संयुक्त संख्या को अभाज्य संख्याओं के गुणनफल के रूप में लिखा जा सकता है। कारण (R): अंकगणित का मौलिक प्रमेय 1 से बड़ी सभी पूर्ण संख्याओं के लिए अद्वितीय अभाज्य गुणनखंडन की गारंटी देता है।
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.
p75mock076.sol: Assertion (A) is true as this statement describes the core concept of prime factorization. Every composite number, by definition, has factors other than 1 and itself, which can eventually be broken down into a product of prime numbers. Reason (R) is true: The Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic states that every integer greater than 1 is either a prime number itself or can be represented as a product of prime numbers. Furthermore, this representation is unique, except for the order in which the prime factors are written.

p75mock078.en: In a quadrilateral APQR, the side QR is extended to S such that RS = PR. If [IMG] QPS = 110° and [IMG] PRQ =70°, then the value of [IMG] PQR is:
p75mock078.hi: चतुर्भुज APQR में , भुजा QR को S तक इस प्रकार बढ़ाया गया है कि RS = PR है। यदि [IMG] QPS = 110° और [IMG] PRQ = 70° है , तो [IMG] PQR का मान क्या है ?
p75mock078.sol: [IMG] ∠ RSP = ∠SPR [RS = PR] ∠ RSP + ∠SPR = ∠PRQ [exterior angle property] 2x = 70 ̊ x =35 ̊ So, ∠QPR = 110 ̊ - 35 ̊ = 75 ̊ In △PQR ∠ PQR = 180 ̊ - [75 ̊ + 70 ̊] = 180 ̊ - 145 ̊ ∠ PQR = 35 ̊

p75mock078.en: A circular wire of diameter 77cm is bent in the form of a rectangle whose length is 142% of its breadth. What is the area of the rectangle? [Take [IMG] = 22/7]
p75mock078.hi: 77 सेमी व्यास वाले एक वृत्ताकार तार को एक आयत के आकार में मोड़ा गया है जिसकी लंबाई इसकी चौड़ाई की 142% है। आयत का क्षेत्रफल क्या है ? [Take [IMG] = 22/7]
p75mock078.sol: circumference of the circle =2πr = × 77=242cm Now let, breadth of rectangle =100x Then its length =142x So, Perimeter =2[l + b] =242 =2[100x +142x] = 242 2 × 242x = 242 x = [IMG] Area of rectangle =100x ×142x =14200x 2 =14200 × [IMG] = 3550cm 2

p75mock078.en: A bucket is drawn from a well by means of a rope which is wound around a wheel of radius 48 cm. If the bucket ascends in 1 minute 12 seconds at a speed of 1.2 m/sec. Find the length of the rope.
p75mock078.hi: एक बाल्टी को एक रस्सी के माध्यम से कुएँ से खींचा जाता है , जो 48 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले एक पहिये के चारों ओर लपेटी हुई है। यदि बाल्टी 1.2 मीटर / सेकंड की गति से 1 मिनट 12 सेकंड में ऊपर आती है। रस्सी की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
p75mock078.sol: Nothing to do with given radius. We are to find the length of the rope, which is simply the distance the bucket travels vertically upward in 72 seconds. Distance = Speed × time = 1.2 m/s × 72s = 86.4m or 864 cm

p75mock078.en: The question consists of two statements numbered I and II given below. You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements is sufficient to answer the question. Find the time taken by a 300-metre-long train to cross a platform of length 1,200 metres. Statement I : The train can cross a 3600-metre-long platform in 60 seconds. Statement II : The train can cross a pole in 15 seconds.
p75mock078.hi: इस प्रश्न में नीचे दिए गए दो कथन I और II शामिल हैं। आपको यह तय करना है कि कथनों में दी गई जानकारी प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है या नहीं। 300 मीटर लंबी एक ट्रेन को 1,200 मीटर लंबे प्लेटफॉर्म को पार करने में कितना समय लगेगा , यह ज्ञात कीजिए। कथन I : ट्रेन 3600 मीटर लंबे प्लेटफॉर्म को 60 सेकंड में पार कर सकती है। कथन II : ट्रेन एक खंभे को 15 सेकंड में पार कर सकती है।
options: The data in Statement I alone are sufficient to answer the question, but the data in Statement II alone are not sufficient.
The data in Statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question, but the data in Statement I alone are not sufficient.
The data in either Statement I alone or Statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question.
The data in both Statement I and Statement II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
p75mock078.sol: t=(Platform(300m)+Train Length (1200m))/Train Speed St1 → 900m platform in 60 sec St2 → Pole in 15sec By St 1 →t= (3600+1200)/s=60→s=80 By St 2→t=1200/S=15⟶S=80 ⇒ Option C

If his average earnings of the first 7 days was ₹519 per day and that of the last week was ₹546 per day, then what was his earning on the 8th day of the fortnight?
p75mock078.hi: राजेंद्र एक बहुराष्ट्रीय कंपनी में डिलीवरी बॉय के रूप में काम कर रहा है। कंपनी उसे प्रति डिलीवरी ₹ 90 का भुगतान कर रही है। 15 लगातार कार्य दिवसों वाले पखवाड़े में , उसकी प्रतिदिन औसत कमाई ₹ 540 थी। यदि पहले 7 दिनों की उसकी औसत कमाई ₹ 519 प्रतिदिन थी और अंतिम सप्ताह की औसत कमाई ₹ 546 प्रतिदिन थी , तो पखवाड़े के 8 वें दिन उसकी कमाई क्या थी ?

p75mock078.en: Original breadth of a rectangular box is 20 cm. The box was then remade in such a way that its length increased by 30% but the breadth decreased by 20% and the area increased by 20% and the area increased by 100 cm ² . what is the new area of the box?
p75mock078.hi: एक आयताकार बॉक्स की मूल चौड़ाई 20 सेमी है। फिर बॉक्स को इस तरह से बनाया गया कि इसकी लंबाई 30% बढ़ गई लेकिन चौड़ाई 20% कम हो गई और क्षेत्रफल 20% बढ़ गया और क्षेत्रफल 100 cm ² बढ़ गया। बॉक्स का नया क्षेत्रफल क्या है ?
p75mock078.sol: let the length of the rectangular box =10l ∴ Original Area of box =20 ×10l New Area of box =16 ×13l =208l Given that, Area Increased by 10cm 2 , then 208l - 200l=100 8l =100 l =12.5 So, New Area of the box =208l =208 ×12.5 =2600cm 2

p75mock079.en: What is the smallest positive number that must be added to the product of any two consecutive odd numbers to make the result a perfect square?
p75mock079.hi: किसी भी दो क्रमागत विषम संख्याओं के गुणनफल में जोड़ने के लिए वह सबसे छोटी धनात्मक संख्या क्या है जिससे परिणाम एक पूर्ण वर्ग बन जाए ?
p75mock079.sol: Let’s take smallest odd integers i.e. 1&3 ⇒ 1×3 = 3 add ‘1’ 4 (Perfect square) Lets take 3&5 3×5 = 15 Add ’1’ 16 (Perfet) 5×7 = 35 Add ‘1’ 36 (Perfect square) ⇒ Minimum number to be added = 1

p75mock079.en: According to Raghav, his weight is more than 64 kg but less than 74 kg. His sister does not agree with Raghav and she thinks that his weight is more than 60 kg but less than 69 kg. His mother's view is that his weight cannot be more than 68 kg. His father's view is that his weight cannot be more than 67 kg. If all are them are correct in their estimation, then what is the average of different probable weights of Raghav measured [in kg]?
p75mock079.hi: राघव के अनुसार , उसका वजन 64 किलोग्राम से ज़्यादा लेकिन 74 किलोग्राम से कम है। उसकी बहन राघव से सहमत नहीं है और उसे लगता है कि उसका वजन 60 किलोग्राम से ज़्यादा लेकिन 69 किलोग्राम से कम है। उसकी माँ का मानना ​​है कि उसका वजन 68 किलोग्राम से ज़्यादा नहीं हो सकता। उसके पिता का मानना ​​है कि उसका वजन 67 किलोग्राम से ज़्यादा नहीं हो सकता। अगर वे सभी अपने अनुमान में सही हैं , तो राघव के अलग - अलग संभावित वज़नों का औसत [ किलोग्राम में ] क्या है ?
p75mock079.sol: Acc. to Raghav, his weight is = 64 Acc. to his sister, =60 And his mother says w≤68, and acc. to father, w≤67 therefore using all possibilities, Possible weights = 65, 66, 67, so, possible Avg = [IMG] = 66kg

p75mock079.hi: एक बाल्टी में 6.25 लीटर पानी आ सकता है। 1 घन मीटर के टैंक को भरने के लिए ऐसी कितनी बाल्टियों की आवश्यकता होगी ?
p75mock079.sol: 1 bucket's capacity =6.25 litres 1m 3 =1000 litres Buckets required =1000/6.25=160

p75mock079.en: A man can row a distance of 6 km in 1 hour in still water. He can row the same distance in 45 minutes with the current. Find the total time taken by him to row a distance of 16 km with the current and to return to the starting point.
p75mock079.hi: एक व्यक्ति स्थिर जल में 1 घंटे में 6 किमी की दूरी तय कर सकता है। वह धारा के साथ समान दूरी 45 मिनट में तय कर सकता है। धारा के साथ 16 किमी की दूरी तय करने और प्रारंभिक बिंदु पर वापस आने में उसे कुल कितना समय लगा ?
p75mock079.sol: Speed of boat = [IMG] = 6km/h Speed in downstream = [IMG] = 8 km/hr Speed of stream = 8 - 6 = 2km/hr Total time taken by him to row a distance of 16 km with the current and to return to the starting point. = [IMG] + [IMG] = 6hours

p75mock079.en: Two pipes A and B can fill a tank in 48 minutes and 66 minutes, respectively. If both the pipes are opened simultaneously, then after how many minutes should pipe B be closed so that the tank gets filled in 32 minutes?
p75mock079.hi: दो पाइप A और B एक टैंक को क्रमशः 48 मिनट और 66 मिनट में भर सकते हैं। यदि दोनों पाइप एक साथ खोले जाते हैं , तो कितने मिनट बाद पाइप B को बंद किया जाना चाहिए ताकि टैंक 32 मिनट में भर जाए ?
p75mock079.sol: [IMG] Let the time at B will be closed ‘t’ ⇒ 528 = 11 × 32 + 8 × t ⇒ 176 = 8 × t ⇒ t = 22 minutes

p75mock079.sol: [IMG] ∠ AOB = [IMG] = [IMG] = 50 ̊

p75mock079.en: BD and CE are the median of [IMG] ABC, right angled at A. If CE = [IMG] cm, BC 10 cm, then the length of BD
p75mock079.hi: BD और CE, ∆ABC की माध्यिकाएँ हैं , जो A पर समकोण है। यदि CE = [IMG] सेमी , BC 10 सेमी , तो BD की लंबाई क्या होगी ?
p75mock079.sol: [IMG] 4[BD 2 + CE 2 ] = 5BC 2 [IMG] = 5×100 4BD 2 + 325 =500 BD = [IMG] BD = [IMG] [IMG] 4[BD 2 + CE 2 ] = 5BC 2 [IMG] = 5×100 4BD 2 + 325 =500 BD = [IMG] BD = [IMG]

p75mock079.en: If sinA + cosA= [IMG] , then find sin 3 A + cos 3 A
p75mock079.hi: यदि sinA + cosA = √ 3 है , तो sin 3 A + cos 3 A ज्ञात कीजिए।
p75mock079.sol: Sin A + Cos A = √ 3 Squaring both sides: Sin² A + Cos² A + 2 Sin A Cos A = 3 (Using the identity Sin² A + Cos² A = 1) ⇒ Sin A Cos A = 1 ……(ii) Sin³ A + Cos³ A = (Sin A + Cos A)(Sin² A + Cos² A - Sin A Cos A) = ( √ 3) (1 - 1) = 0

p75mock079.en: A train travels at a speed of 66 km/h and halts at five junctions for a certain time. If covers a distance of 1485 km in one day. For how long [in minutes] does the train stop at each junction, if it halts for the same period of time at all the junction?
p75mock079.hi: एक रेलगाड़ी 66 किमी / घंटा की गति से चलती है और एक निश्चित समय के लिए पाँच जंक्शनों पर रुकती है। यदि यह एक दिन में 1485 किमी की दूरी तय करती है। यदि यह सभी जंक्शनों पर समान समय के लिए रुकती है , तो रेलगाड़ी प्रत्येक जंक्शन पर कितने समय [ मिनटों में ] रुकती है ?
p75mock079.sol: W ithout stoppage train moves 66 × 24[One day = 24 hours] = 1584 kms With stoppage train moves [1584 – 1485] = 99 km less Time takes to cover 99 km by train with speed of 66 km/h = [IMG] = 1.5 hours or 90 minutes Duration of each stops = [IMG] = 18 min

p75mock079.en: The sides of a triangle are 10cm, 24 cm and 26 cm. At each of its vertices, circles of radius 3.5 cm are drawn. What is the area of the triangle excluding the portion covered by the sectors of the circles? [Take [IMG] = 22/7]
p75mock079.hi: एक त्रिभुज की भुजाएँ 10 सेमी , 24 सेमी और 26 सेमी हैं। इसके प्रत्येक शीर्ष पर 3.5 सेमी त्रिज्या के वृत्त खींचे गए हैं। वृत्तों के त्रिज्यखंडों द्वारा कवर किए गए भाग को छोड़कर त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल क्या है ? [Take [IMG] = 22/7]
p75mock079.sol: Area of triangle = [IMG] ×10 × 24 = 120 cm 2 [IMG] Area of circles inside the triangle = [IMG] × [IMG] × [IMG] × [IMG] = [IMG] =19.25 ∴ required Area =120 - 19.25 =100.75cm 2

p75mock079.en: A prism with a square base of side length 6 cm is constructed in layers. Its height follows an arithmetic progression, increasing from 5 cm in the first layer to 17 cm in the fourth layer. What is the total volume of the prism?
p75mock079.hi: 6 cm भुजा वाले एक वर्गाकार आधार वाला प्रिज्म परतों में बनाया गया है। इसकी ऊँचाई एक समांतर श्रेणी (AP) का अनुसरण करती है , जो पहली परत में 5 cm से बढ़कर चौथी परत में 17 cm हो जाती है। इस प्रिज्म का कुल आयतन कितना है ?
p75mock079.sol: Base Area = (side)² =6²=36cm² First height =5cm Fourth height =17cm n=4 Sum of heights =4/2(5+17)cm =44cm Volume = Base Area × Total height =44cm×36cm² =1584cm³.

p75mock079.en: In an election between two candidates, the defeated candidate secured 42% of the valid votes polled and lost the election by 7,68,400 votes. If 82,560 votes were declared invalid and 20% people did NOT cast their vote, then the invalid votes were what percentage [rounded off to one decimal place] of the votes which people did NOT cast?
p75mock079.hi: दो उम्मीदवारों के बीच हुए चुनाव में , पराजित उम्मीदवार को डाले गए वैध मतों में से 42% मत प्राप्त हुए और वह 7,68,400 मतों से चुनाव हार गया। यदि 82,560 मत अवैध घोषित किए गए और 20% लोगों ने अपना वोट नहीं डाला , तो अवैध मत उन मतों का कितना प्रतिशत एक दशमलव स्थान तक पूर्णांकित थे जिन्हें लोगों ने नहीं डाला ?
p75mock079.sol: % of total valid votes by winning candidates = 100 – 42 = 58 Difference between winning & defeated candidate = 58 – 42 = 16% Total no. of valid votes = [IMG] ×100=4802500 Total no. of votes = 4802500 + 82560 = 4885060 As 20% people did not cast their vote, so, 80% people casted = [IMG] = 6106325 No. of people who didn’t cast vote =6106325×20% =1221265 Now %= [IMG] ×100=6.8% Approx

p75mock079.en: A cell phone is available for ₹600 or for ₹300 cash down payment together with ₹360 to be paid after two months. Find the rate of interest charged under this scheme.
p75mock079.hi: एक सेल फोन ₹ 600 में उपलब्ध है या ₹ 300 नकद अग्रिम भुगतान के साथ ₹ 360 दो महीने बाद चुकाने हैं। इस योजना के तहत ली जाने वाली ब्याज दर ज्ञात कीजिए।
p75mock079.sol: Total interest to be paid = [300+360]-600 660-600=60Rs ∴ as per question, let rate =r%. 60=300× [IMG] × [IMG] Hence option B is correct.

p75mock079.en: A sum of Rs x amounts to Rs. 9,246 in 4 years and to Rs. 11,298.75 in [IMG] years, at y% p.a. simple interest. The values of x and y are, respectively:
p75mock079.hi: x रुपये की एक राशि y% प्रति वर्ष साधारण ब्याज की दर से 4 वर्ष में 9,246 रुपये तथा [IMG] वर्ष में 11,298.75 रुपये हो जाती है। x तथा y के मान क्रमशः हैं :
p75mock079.sol: [IMG]

p75mock080.en: An L- shaped floor is made of two rectangles (5m x 3m and 7m x 6m). Tiles cost ₹500/m 2 , but a 15% discount is given if more than 60m 2 is tiled. What is the total cost after the discount?
p75mock080.hi: L- आकार का एक फ़र्श दो आयतों (5m x 3m और 7m x 6m) से बना है। टाइल्स की कीमत ₹ 500/m² है , लेकिन अगर 60m² से ज़्यादा जगह पर टाइल्स लगवाई जाती हैं , तो 15% की छूट दी जाती है। छूट के बाद कुल लागत कितनी होगी ?
p75mock080.sol: Area of rectangle 1 with dimension 5 m × 3 m = 15 m² Area of rectangle 2 = 7 m × 6 m = 42 m² Total Area = 15 m² + 42 m² = 57 m² Sine, the area is less than 60 m², so no discount is applicable. Total cost = 57 m² × 500 ₹/m² = ₹28,500

p75mock080.en: Asha and Suman’s mud forts have heights 9 cm and 16 cm. They are 24 cm apart. How far [in cm] are the fort tops from each other?
p75mock080.hi: आशा और सुमन के मिट्टी के किलों की ऊँचाई 9 cm और 16 cm है। वे एक - दूसरे से 24 cm की दूरी पर हैं। किलों के शिखर एक - दूसरे से कितनी दूरी [cm में ] पर हैं ?
p75mock080.sol: [IMG] ∴ AC² = 7² + 24² Using triplet 7, 24, 25 AC = 25cm

p75mock080.en: The distance between two stations A and B is 800 km. A train X starts from A and moves towards B at 40 km/hr and another train Y starts from B and moves towards A at 60 km/hr. How far from A will they cross each other?
p75mock080.hi: दो स्टेशनों A और B के बीच की दूरी 800 किमी है। एक ट्रेन X, A से शुरू होकर B की ओर 40 किमी / घंटा की गति से चलती है और दूसरी ट्रेन Y, B से शुरू होकर A की ओर 60 किमी / घंटा की गति से चलती है। A से कितनी दूरी पर वे एक दूसरे को पार करेंगी ?
p75mock080.sol: Relative speed = 40 + 60 =100km/h Time taken to meet each other = [IMG] = 8hrs A Covered the distance = 40 × 8 = 320km

p75mock080.en: A family spends ₹240 per month to buy sugar. A rise of 25% in the price of sugar compels the family to reduce the monthly consumption of sugar by 1.5 kg as it decides to spend the same amount of money on purchase of the commodity. What is the increased price per kg of sugar?
p75mock080.hi: एक परिवार चीनी खरीदने के लिए हर महीने ₹ 240 खर्च करता है। चीनी की कीमत में 25% की वृद्धि होने पर परिवार को चीनी की मासिक खपत में 1.5 किलोग्राम की कमी करनी पड़ती है क्योंकि वह उसी राशि को चीनी की खरीद पर खर्च करने का फैसला करता है। चीनी की प्रति किलोग्राम बढ़ी हुई कीमत क्या है ?

p75mock080.en: A solid cube of side 15 cm is dropped into a rectangular container of length 25 cm, breadth 20 cm and height 18 cm, which is partly filled with water. If the cube is completely submerged, then the rise of water [in cm] is:
p75mock080.hi: 15 सेमी भुजा वाला एक ठोस घन 25 सेमी लंबाई , 20 सेमी चौड़ाई और 18 सेमी ऊंचाई वाले एक आयताकार कंटेनर में डाला जाता है , जो आंशिक रूप से पानी से भरा हुआ है। यदि घन पूरी तरह से डूब जाता है , तो पानी का बढ़ना [ सेमी में ] है :
p75mock080.sol: Volume of cuboid = l × b × h Volume of cube = a³ ⇒ 15 ×15 ×15 = 25 × 20 × h ⇒ h = 6.75cm If the cube is completely submerged, the water level rise be 6.75cm

p75mock080.en: A vessel contained a solution of acid and water, in which water was 64%. Four litres of the solution was taken out of the vessel and the same quantity of water was added. If the resulting solution contains 30% acid, the quantity [in litres] of the water in the solution, at the beginning in the vessel, was:
p75mock080.hi: एक बर्तन में अम्ल और पानी का घोल था , जिसमें पानी 64% था। बर्तन से चार लीटर घोल निकाला गया और उतनी ही मात्रा में पानी मिलाया गया। यदि परिणामी घोल में 30% अम्ल है , तो बर्तन में शुरुआत में घोल में पानी की मात्रा [ लीटर में ] थी :
p75mock080.sol: Let the quantity of solution after 4 litres taken out = x Acid is fixed: So, as per question, x ×36%=[x+4] ×30 i.e , x=20 Therefore initial quantity of solution = 20+4 = 24 litres Initial quantity of water = 24×64% = 15.36 %

p75mock080.en: A sum of money amounts to ₹16,800 in one year and to ₹17,472 in one and a half years on the basis of interest compounded semi-annually. What is the rate of interest per annum?
p75mock080.hi: अर्ध - वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित ब्याज के आधार पर एक धनराशि एक वर्ष में ₹ 16,800 तथा डेढ़ वर्ष में ₹ 17,472 हो जाती है। प्रति वर्ष ब्याज की दर क्या है ?
p75mock080.sol: Amount = [IMG] [IMG] = [IMG] = [IMG] r = [IMG] ×100 = 4% The rate of interest per annum = 8%

p75mock080.en: If the difference between the compound interest and simple interest at 17% on a sum of money for 2 years [compounded annually] is ₹433.50. Then the compound interest [in ₹] is:
p75mock080.hi: यदि किसी धनराशि पर 2 वर्षों के लिए 17% की दर से चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज और साधारण ब्याज के बीच का अंतर [ वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित ] ₹433.50 है। तो चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज [₹ में ] है :
p75mock080.sol: Difference between the CI and SI =[IMG] ⇒[IMG] = ₹433.50 ⇒[IMG] = 15000 SI for 2 years = [IMG] = 5100 CI = 5100+433.50=₹5,533.50

p75mock080.en: A vendor sold 12 toys for ₹2,400 and gained a profit of 20%. How many toys should he sell for ₹3,300 to make a profit of 10%?
p75mock080.hi: एक विक्रेता ने 12 खिलौने ₹2,400 में बेचे और 20% का लाभ कमाया । उसे 10% लाभ कमाने के लिए ₹3,300 में कितने खिलौने बेचने चाहिए ?

p75mock080.en: An article is sold at a certain price at. If it is sold at 33 [IMG] % of this price, there is a loss of 33 [IMG] %. What is the percentage profit or percentage loss when it is sold at 40% of the original selling price?
p75mock080.hi: एक वस्तु को एक निश्चित मूल्य पर बेचा जाता है। यदि इसे इस मूल्य के 33 [IMG] % पर बेचा जाता है , तो 33 [IMG] % की हानि होती है। जब इसे मूल विक्रय मूल्य के 40% पर बेचा जाता है तो प्रतिशत लाभ या प्रतिशत हानि क्या है ?
p75mock080.sol: Let SP = 9 New SP at 33 [IMG] %=9× [IMG] = 3 Loss =33 [IMG] %→CP=3× [IMG] CP = 4.5 40% of SP = 9× [IMG] = 3.6 Loss % = [IMG] ×100 = [IMG] ×100 = 20% loss

p75mock080.en: Which line is not parallel to the line 8x-4y=12?
p75mock080.hi: कौन सी रेखा रेखा 8x-4y=12 के समानांतर नहीं है ?
p75mock080.sol: 8x − 4y = 12 ←→ ax + by = c Here, Slope = −a/b = −8/−4 = 2 ⇒ Line parallel to the line must have slope = 2 Answer = Option (3) y=3x−1 Slope = 3 ⇒ not parallel

p75mock080.en: A software developer sells a license for a new application to a reseller at a 20% discount. An installation and support fee of 15% is added to the discounted price. The reseller then sells the license for ₹7,800 more, making a 25% profit. Determine the original marked price of the software license by the developer.
p75mock080.hi: एक सॉफ़्टवेयर डेवलपर एक नए एप्लिकेशन का लाइसेंस एक रीसैलर को 20% की छूट पर बेचता है । इस छूट के बाद मूल्य में 15% इंस्टॉलेशन और सपोर्ट शुल्क जोड़ा जाता है । फिर रीसैलर लाइसेंस को ₹7,800 अधिक में बेचता है , जिससे उसे 25% का लाभ होता है । डेवलपर द्वारा सॉफ़्टवेयर लाइसेंस का मूल अंकित मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए ।
p75mock080.sol: Developer let MP be x SP = x×8/10 × 115/100 = 0.92x Reseller CP=SP of Developer = 0.92x SP= 0.92x+7800, P=25% →SP = 5 CP /Y = 0.92x + 7800 5/4 × 0.92x = 0.92x+7800 →MP = x = ₹ 33913.04

p75mock080.en: A reduction of 7.5% in the cost price of a commodity enables a shopkeeper to purchase 15 kg more than what he previously purchased for a sum of ₹7,400. In order to make a profit of 32.5% on the pre-reduction cost price of the commodity, at what price [in ₹] per kg. should the commodity be sold?
p75mock080.hi: किसी वस्तु के क्रय मूल्य में 7.5% की कमी होने पर एक दुकानदार को पहले खरीदी गई वस्तु से 15 किग्रा अधिक वस्तु खरीदने में सक्षम बनाता है , जिसकी कीमत ₹ 7,400 है। वस्तु के कटौती - पूर्व क्रय मूल्य पर 32.5% का लाभ कमाने के लिए , वस्तु को प्रति किग्रा किस मूल्य [ ₹ में ] पर बेचा जाना चाहिए ?
p75mock080.sol: The reduced price=7400× [IMG] =555 15 kg=555 1 kg= [IMG] =₹37/kg= Reduced Price per kg Original Price per kg=37× [IMG] =₹40/kg New S.P =40× [IMG] =₹53 per kg.

p75mock080.en: A sum of ₹10,000 is taken as a loan by Rajesh at a rate of 15% p.a. simple interest for 2 years. p75mock080.sol: Amount after 2 years =10,000×130% =13,000 ∴ Principal for Next 2yr=13,000 Amount on this after 2yr =13,000×130%=16900

p75mock080.en: The monthly salary of a person was 1,60,000. He used to spend on three heads Personal and family expenses [P], Taxes [T] and Education loan [E]. The rest were his savings. P was 50% of the income, E was 20% of P, and T was 15% of E. When his salary got raised by 30%, he maintained the percentage level of P, but E became 30% of P and T became 20% of E. The sum of the two savings [in Rs.] is:
p75mock080.hi: एक व्यक्ति का मासिक वेतन 1,60,000 था। वह तीन मदों व्यक्तिगत और पारिवारिक व्यय [P], कर [T] और शिक्षा ऋण [E] पर खर्च करता था। बाकी उसकी बचत थी। P आय का 50% था , E, P का 20% था , और T, E का 15% था। जब उसका वेतन 30% बढ़ा , तो उसने P का प्रतिशत स्तर बनाए रखा , लेकिन E, P का 30% हो गया और T, E का 20% हो गया। दोनों बचतों का योग [ रुपये में ] है :
p75mock080.sol: Salary = 100x P = 50x E = 10x T = 1.5x Savings = 38.5x New salary = 130x P = 65x E = 19.5x T = 3.9x Savings = 41.6x Sum of two savings = 38.5x + 41.6x = 80.1x 100x→160000 80.1x→128160

If Ramanna could sell his product at a price to earn an overall profit of 20% after offering a discount of 20%, how many times of the total cost of the raw materials purchased was the marked price of the product?

p75mock080.sol: let CP of Raw material =100 Raw Mat. Used =100-22.5=77.5 Manufacturing Cost=77.5× [IMG] =62 Total CP=100+62=162 [IMG] = [IMG] = [IMG] [IMG] ⟶ 2.43 times

p75mock081.en: A sum of ₹15,000 is invested partly at 12% per annum and the remaining at 10% per annum simple interest. If the total interest at the end of 2 years is ₹3,344 how much money was invested at 10% per annum.

p75mock081.sol: If whole sum is Inverted at [IMG] Per annum; We got [IMG] = 3600 Rs. But we get 3344 Rs. i.e. 3600-3344=256 Rs. less Amount due to 10% Interest on second part i.e. 2% less rate ∴ 4% →256 1% ⟶64 100% =6400 ∴ Sum of 2 nd part =6400 Rs. Alternate Method : Let money Invested on 10% is x Rs then; [IMG] + [IMG] = 3344 10x+180000-12x=167200 2x=12800 x=6400

p75mock081.sol: Quantity of rice =1:5 Now, Total cost of rice = 65×1 +95×5 = 65+475= ₹540 Selling price =₹99×6=₹594 % gain = [IMG] ×100 = [IMG] ×100 =10%
